blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.
blocks.zh: CLIP风格的双编码器通过两个独立的塔将图像和文本映射到一个共享的嵌入空间,两种模式占据了被模式间隙分隔的不同区域. 错误匹配时检索失败,或硬负数,排在正确位置后,缺口是通常的疑犯. 但是,移除它后临时功能会降低我们测试的每个CLIP检查站的检索。 我们引入一个对齐统计, 确定两个塔在硬底片上比在配对上更一致的方向。 略微缩小这些方向可以改善检索,同时在很大程度上保持差距。 我们通过加权空间编程实现这种校正:在统计学的指引下,一个LLM代理检查两座塔,并写闭式的重量编辑,而不反射. 该代理可以自由编辑任何组件,改进所有13个CLIP检查站的COCO测试检索,并编辑13个中12个的输出预测. 我们将其反复出现的校正精炼成Tower Bridge,一种封闭式配方,以硬负差的一阶分析为动机. 从25,000个标签对数中数秒计算出来,它不需要特定的模型调制,而使架构和推论成本保持不变. TowerBridge在所有21个经评价的CLIP检查站平均改进了16.8 RSUM的COCO测试检索和6.6的Flickr30k测试检索,包括代理商看不见的8个,同时将ImageNet零射精度的任何下降限制在0.5点。 该系统还减少了所有21个检查站的枢纽性,改进了从其他家庭取回5个双重编码器中的4个。

Figure 1 : A mild shrink of hard-negative directions improves retrieval, whereas removing the modality gap hurts. (a) A caption retrieves a hub photo instead of the correct match.
(b) Guided by our paired statistic 𝐃 \mathbf{D} , Astra finds that removing the gap hurts in all 13 sessions, whereas a mild shrink helps; 12 of 13 patches edit an output projection.
(c) Astra’s ViT-B/32 patch ranks the correct photo first and reduces hub wins.
(d) TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval on all 21 CLIP checkpoints without the agent.

图一:硬负方向的温和收缩能改善检索,而去除模式间隙会伤害. (a) 标题取回中心相片,而不是正确的相配相片。
(b) 以我们的配对统计D\ mathbf{D} 为指导, Astra 发现在所有13个会话中消除空隙会伤害到人, 而一个温和的收缩会有所帮助; 13个补丁中的12个编辑输出投影.
(c) Astra的Vit-B/32补丁将正确的相片排在首位并减少中枢取胜。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image–text retrieval commonly relies on dual encoders such as CLIP [ 41 , 6 ] .
Yet a caption can retrieve the wrong image even when its correct match is available (Fig. 1 ).
These high-scoring incorrect matches are known as hard negatives .
For OpenAI’s ViT-B/16, 41% of text-to-image misses on COCO concentrate on hub images that are retrieved for many captions they do not match [ 42 , 5 ] .
Each tower maps its input into a shared embedding space, yet the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap [ 33 ] , the usual suspect for such errors.
blocks.zh:
Image -text reference 通常依赖CLIP等双编码器[41,6].
然而,一个标题可以获取错误的图像,即使其正确匹配是可用的(图1)。
这些高分不正确的匹配被称为硬底.
对OpenAI的Vit-B/16来说, 41%的文本到图像缺失在COCO上,
每个塔楼将其输入的输入图映入一个共享的嵌入空间,然而两种模式占据了被模式间隙相隔的不同区域[33],这种错误的通常被怀疑.

blocks.en:
A natural remedy is to close it.
However, reducing it [ 3 ] does not reliably improve zero-shot classification [ 46 ] or retrieval [ 24 ] , and in our experiments removing it degrades retrieval on every checkpoint.
Fine-tuning [ 26 ] improves retrieval but requires gradient-based optimization and hyperparameter tuning, while test-time re-ranking [ 5 , 9 , 51 , 7 , 64 ] requires a bank of queries or reference samples and leaves the model unchanged.
It remains unclear what should change in the weights where the two towers meet.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的补救办法就是关闭它。
然而,减少[3]并不能可靠地改进零发分级[46]或取回[24],而且我们的实验中去除它会降低每个检查站的取回.
微调 [26] 改进了检索,但要求基于梯度的优化和超参数调取,而测试时重排[5,9,51,7,64]则需要一库查询或参考样本,并保持模型不变.
目前仍不清楚两座塔相会地点的重量应该有什么变化.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we show that the directions favoring hard negatives should be mildly attenuated rather than removed (Fig. 1 ).
We introduce a paired statistic 𝐃 \mathbf{D} that identifies these hard-negative directions , where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs.
A 10% shrink of these directions gains + 12.5 +12.5 COCO validation RSUM on average, against at most + 0.3 +0.3 for as many top principal directions chosen without pair labels.
The two leading directions align with the common mean and the modality gap.
Removing them degrades retrieval on every checkpoint, whereas shrinking them by 10% improves every one.
These directions carry useful content, which a mild shrink retains.
Applied to the hard-negative directions, it widens hard-negative margins and reduces hubness while largely preserving the gap’s size.
We call this effect bridging .
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们表明,倾向于硬负数的方向应当被轻而易举地削弱而不是去除(图1)。
我们引入一个对齐的统计 D\ mathbf{D} 来识别这些硬阴性的方向, 两个塔在硬阴性上比在匹配的对上更一致。
平均而言,这些方向的收缩10%可增加+12.5+12.5COCO验证RSUM,而最多可增加+0.3+0.3。
两个主要方向与共同的平均值和模式差距一致。
拆除它们会降低每个检查站的检索率,而缩小10%则会提高每个检查站的检索率。
这些方向带有有用的内容,温和的收缩者保留了这些内容.
应用到硬负方向上,它扩大了硬负边际,并减少了中枢性,同时在很大程度上保持了差距的大小.
我们称之为这种效果的连接。

blocks.en:
We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming [ 54 ] : an LLM agent, Astra, inspects both towers and writes short programs that directly edit their weights without gradients.
The agent can edit any component of either tower, from attention heads to output projections.
We run one session on each of 13 CLIP checkpoints, and each produces a patch , the set of edits the agent keeps.
We design and supply 𝐃 \mathbf{D} as evidence that the weights alone do not reveal, and the agent chooses where and how to intervene.
In controls, removing 𝐃 \mathbf{D} reduces the agent’s gains more than removing access to the raw weights (Sec. 4.2 ).
Of its 13 final patches, 12 rewrite an output projection, and most mildly attenuate the directions identified by 𝐃 \mathbf{D} .
blocks.zh:
我们通过权重空间编程[54]:一个LLM代理,Astra,检查两个塔并写出短程序,直接编辑它们的权重而无梯度.
代理可以编辑任一塔的任何组件,从注意头到输出预测.
我们在13个CLIP检查站各开一个课,
我们设计和提供 D\ mathbf{D} 以证明重量本身不显露, 并且代理商选择干预的地点和方式 。
在控件中,去除 D\ mathbf{ D} 要比去除对生重的取用( 第4.2 条) 来减少代理商的收益 。
在其13个最终补丁中,有12个重写出一个输出投影,并且最温和地减弱了由 D\mathbf{D} 确定的方向.

blocks.en:
We distill and refine this correction into TowerBridge , a closed-form recipe with three steps (Fig. 2 ).
It computes 𝐃 \mathbf{D} from 25,000 labelled pairs, applies a 10% shrink in both output projections to the quarter of directions that most favor hard negatives, and re-mines hard negatives to apply a second, smaller shrink.
The recipe takes seconds for each model and requires no agent.
blocks.zh:
我们把校正提炼成Tower Bridge,
它从25,000个标签对中计算出 D\ mathbf{D},在两种输出预测中将10%的收缩应用到最倾向于硬底片的四分之一方向,再将硬底片去再去矿以应用第二个更小的收缩.
每个模型的配方需要几秒钟,不需要任何代理.

blocks.en:
Astra improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 checkpoints, by + 12.2 +12.2 RSUM on average (the sum of recall at 1, 5, and 10 in both directions).
On COCO test, TowerBridge improves all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints by + 16.8 +16.8 RSUM on average, including 8 unseen by the agent, 3 of them downloaded after the recipe was fixed.
It improves Flickr30k test retrieval by + 6.6 +6.6 while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to half a percentage point.
Across these checkpoints, the median share of text-to-image misses landing on hubs falls from 28% to 19%.
TowerBridge also outperforms the agent’s own patches on all 13 checkpoints with a session and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.
TowerBridge involves no gradient-based optimization or hyperparameter search, needs no test-time reference bank, and adds no inference cost.
blocks.zh:
Astra改进了所有13个检查站的COCO测试检索,平均为+12.2+12.2 RSUM(收复总和为1、5和10个方向)。
在COCO测试中, Tower Bridge平均通过+16.8+16.8 RSUM改进了所有21个经评价的CLIP检查站,包括代理商看不见的8个检查站,其中3个检查站在食谱定好后下载。
它改进了Flickr30k测试检索+6.6+6.6,同时将ImageNet零发精度的任何下降限制在半个百分点.
通过这些检查站,短信到图像的中位数没有到达枢纽,从28%下降到19%。
TowerBridge也比所有13个检查站的代理员的补丁还要好,并改进了对来自其他家庭的5个双码器中的4个的检索。
Tower Bridge不涉及基于梯度的优化或超参数搜索,不需要测试时间参考库,也不增加推论成本.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We show which directions to change and how: removing the leading hard-negative directions, which align with the common mean and the gap, degrades retrieval, whereas mildly shrinking hard-negative directions improves it while largely preserving the gap’s size (Sec. 4.3 ). • We introduce a paired statistic that identifies these directions and use it to guide an LLM agent that can edit any component of either tower. The agent’s edits improve retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints, evaluated on test sets that it never accesses, and converge on the output projections (Sec. 4.2 ). • We develop TowerBridge , an agent-free, closed-form method motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin (Sec. 3.3 ). It improves all 21 CLIP checkpoints we evaluate and 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families, and outperforms the agent’s own patches (Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 我们说明要改变的方向以及如何:去除与共同的平均值和差距相一致的主要硬阴性取向会降低检索,而轻而易举地收缩硬阴性取向则会改善检索,同时在很大程度上保持差距的大小(第4.3节)。 我们引入一个对齐的统计,来识别这些方向,并利用它来引导一个LLM代理,可以编辑任一塔的任何组件. 该代理人的编辑改进了所有13个CLIP检查站的检索,在它从未进入的测试设备上进行了评价,并统一了产出预测(第4.2节)。 我们开发了Tower Bridge,一种无毒剂的封闭式方法,其动机是对硬负边值进行一等分析(第3.3条)。 它改进了我们评价的所有21个CLIP检查站,以及来自其他家庭的5个双重编码器中的4个,并且超过了代理商自己的补丁(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: We show which directions to change and how: removing the leading hard-negative directions, which align with the common mean and the gap, degrades retrieval, whereas mildly shrinking hard-negative directions improves it while largely preserving the gap’s size (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们指出要改变的方向以及如何:删除与共同的平均值和差距相一致的主要硬阴性取向会降低检索,而轻而易举地缩小硬阴性取向则会改善检索,同时在很大程度上保持差距的大小(第4.3条)。

blocks.en: We introduce a paired statistic that identifies these directions and use it to guide an LLM agent that can edit any component of either tower. The agent’s edits improve retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints, evaluated on test sets that it never accesses, and converge on the output projections (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们引入一个对齐的统计,来识别这些方向,并利用它来引导一个LLM代理,可以编辑任一塔的任何组件. 该代理人的编辑改进了所有13个CLIP检查站的检索,在它从未进入的测试设备上进行了评价,并统一了产出预测(第4.2条)。

blocks.en: We develop TowerBridge , an agent-free, closed-form method motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin (Sec. 3.3 ). It improves all 21 CLIP checkpoints we evaluate and 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families, and outperforms the agent’s own patches (Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们开发了Tower Bridge,一种无毒剂的封闭式方法,其动机是对硬负边值进行一等分析(第3.3条)。 它改进了我们评价的所有21个CLIP检查站,以及来自其他家庭的5个双重编码器中的4个,并且超过了代理商自己的补丁(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : From an agent session to the TowerBridge recipe. Top: Astra inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits using our paired statistic 𝐃 \mathbf{D} and COCO validation feedback. Astra’s final patch is evaluated once on sealed test sets. Bottom: TowerBridge combines the agent’s projection shrink with our re-mining and refinement step in an agent-free recipe that improves all 21 CLIP checkpoints on COCO test. 𝐃 \mathbf{D} and its spectrum are real.
blocks.zh: 图2:从代理会话到塔布里奇食谱. 顶: Astra 检查两座高塔, 并使用我们配对的统计 D\ mathbf{D} 和 COCO 验证反馈来撰写闭式重量编辑 。 Astra 的最终补丁在密封的测试装置上被评估一次。 Tower Bridge将毒剂的投影收缩与我们的再开采和完善步骤结合起来, D\ mathbf{D} 及其光谱是真实的 。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Modality gap and retrieval correction. CLIP’s image and text embeddings occupy separate regions [ 33 ] , with recent work relating this gap to information imbalance [ 47 ] .
Methods reduce the gap [ 3 ] , although this does not consistently improve zero-shot classification [ 46 ] or retrieval [ 24 ] .
We instead identify which directions to change: retrieval improves by mildly attenuating directions that favor hard negatives while largely preserving the gap.
Centering [ 53 ] and all-but-the-top [ 40 ] remove mean and top-variance directions chosen without pair labels, which lowers CLIP retrieval; shrinking them mildly gains little (see the supplement).
Hubness is a related problem in high-dimensional nearest-neighbor search [ 42 , 12 ] .
Inverted softmax [ 51 ] , CSLS [ 9 ] , QB-Norm [ 5 ] , DBNorm [ 58 ] , NNN [ 7 ] , and DN [ 64 ] correct rankings using queries or reference samples at test time.
Our correction is written into the checkpoint, adds no inference cost, and complements re-ranking.
Fine-tuning [ 26 ] also modifies weights but requires gradient-based optimization and hyperparameter search.
blocks.zh:
模式差距和检索修正。 CLIP的形象和文字嵌入占据了不同的区域[33],最近的工作将这一差距与信息不平衡[47]有关。
方法缩小了差距[3],尽管这并不能持续地改进零镜头分类[46]或检索[24].
相反,我们确定需要改变的方向:通过轻而易举地缩小有利于硬负数的方向,同时在很大程度上保持差距,检索得到改善。
居中 [53] 和全上 [40]去掉在没有对标签的情况下选择的正向和上向变化方向,这降低了CLIP检索率;而缩小这些方向则略有增益(见补编).
Hubness是高维度近邻搜索[42,12]中的一个相关问题.
倒置软马克 [51], CSLS [9], QB-Norm [5], DBNorm [58], NNN [7], DN [64] 在测试时使用查询或参考样本进行正确的排名.
我们的更正写入检查站,不增加推论费用,并补充重新排列。
微调 [26] 也修改了权重,但需要以梯度为基础的优化和超参数搜索.

blocks.en:
Weight-space programming. Weight-space programming [ 54 ] introduces a new way to modify neural networks: an LLM agent inspects their weights and edits them directly without gradients.
WeightLoop [ 32 ] develops this direction through experimental feedback and reuse of editing programs, alongside broader efforts in LLM-driven discovery [ 43 , 36 ] .
We study cross-modal retrieval, where success depends on how two towers represent matched pairs relative to hard negatives.
Our paired statistic provides evidence about this relationship, while the agent chooses where and how to edit.
We use these sessions to discover a recurring correction and turn it into a recipe that transfers to unseen checkpoints without the agent.
Recent questions about the role of weight access and the consistency of agent-written edits [ 35 , 1 , 27 ] also motivate our controlled evaluation.
blocks.zh:
重量空间编程. 重量-空间编程 [54]引入了修改神经网络的新方式:一个LLM代理检查它们的重量并直接编辑它们而不用梯度.
加权Loop[32]通过实验反馈和编辑程序的再利用,同时在LLM驱动的发现方面作出更广泛的努力来发展这个方向[43,36].
我们研究跨模式检索,成功与否取决于两座高塔如何代表相配对相对于硬底.
我们的配对统计提供了这种关系的证据,而代理则选择编辑地点和方式.
我们利用这些会议来发现一再发生的更正,并把它变成一种在没有代理人的情况下转移到隐蔽检查站的秘方。
关于权重访问作用和代理写作编辑一致性的最新问题[35, 1, 27]也激励了我们的受控评价.

blocks.en:
Interpreting and editing CLIP. Mechanistic interpretability connects model behavior to internal components [ 14 , 8 ] .
For CLIP, this includes attention heads [ 21 ] , neurons [ 22 ] , and artifact tokens [ 10 , 29 ] ; LLM-based tools further automate component analysis [ 4 , 44 ] .
The closest editing methods include SITH [ 23 ] , which rescales singular directions in vision heads, and IsoCLIP [ 37 ] , which analyzes both output projections for intra-modal retrieval.
Our agent can investigate components in either tower, guided by paired evidence that identifies where their agreement favors incorrect matches.
This connects component analysis to explicit weight edits for cross-modal retrieval.
More broadly, model editing changes facts, rules, or task behavior [ 38 , 39 , 45 , 28 ] ; our objective concerns the two encoders’ joint ranking.
blocks.zh:
解读与编辑 CLIP. 机械解释性将模型行为与内部组件相连接[14,8].
就CLIP而言,这包括注意头[21],神经元[22],以及文物符号[10,29];基于LLM的工具进一步将组件分析自动化[4,44].
最接近的编辑方法包括:SITH [23],在视觉头部重新标出单向;IsoCLIP [37],分析两种输出预测,用于模式内检索.
我们的特工可以调查任一塔的部件, 以对齐的证据为指导, 找出他们的协议偏好不正确的匹配之处。
它将组件分析与用于跨模式检索的明确加权编辑联系起来。
更宽泛地说,模型编辑会改变事实、规则或任务行为[38、39、45、28];我们的目标涉及两个编码员的联合排名。

blocks.en:
Hard negatives and closed-form metrics. Hard negatives [ 15 , 2 ] and neighborhood losses [ 55 ] guide retrieval training, while KISSME [ 31 ] computes a metric from similar and dissimilar pairs.
Our paired statistic 𝐃 \mathbf{D} identifies directions where the towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs, providing explicit targets for weight edits.
The agent’s recurring correction motivates TowerBridge, which mildly shrinks these directions in both output projections.
We establish the optimality of its first shrink for a bilinear margin surrogate under per-direction and total contraction constraints, with the conditions specified in Sec. 3.3 .
This connects an agent-discovered edit to a closed-form recipe that requires no agent or model-specific tuning.

我们的配对统计 D\ mathbf{D} 确定塔在硬负数上比相匹配的对数更一致的方向, 为重量编辑提供明确的目标 。
该剂的反复修正激发了Tower Bridge的积极性,这在两种输出预测中都轻而易举地缩小了这些方向.
我们确定它的首次收缩在每向和总收缩限制下的双线边距替代物的最佳性,条件在第3.3.节中规定。
这可以将一个被发现的代理编辑器连接到一个不需要代理或模型特异性调取的封闭式配方.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We study which weight edits help matched pairs outrank hard negatives in a pretrained dual encoder.
We first define a paired statistic that identifies the directions favoring hard negatives.
Guided by this statistic, Astra inspects the model and writes short, closed-form weight edits without backpropagation.
We then turn its recurring correction to the output projections into TowerBridge, a simple recipe that can be applied to new checkpoints without the agent (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们研究哪些重量编辑有助于匹配对数 超过预训双编码器中的硬负数
我们首先定义一个对齐的统计, 找出倾向于硬负数的方向。
在这项统计的指引下,Astra检查了模型并写出短而封闭的重量编辑而无需反向传播.
然后,我们将其对产出预测的反复纠正变为Tower Bridge,这是一种简单的方法,可以在没有代理人的情况下适用于新的检查站(图2)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Setup and the Paired Statistic
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置和Paired统计

blocks.en:
Given an image or caption, retrieval aims to rank its matched counterpart above the other candidates.
CLIP computes the two representations separately: e v = W v ​ h v ​ ( x ) e_{v}=W_{v}h_{v}(x) for an image x x and e t = W t ​ h t ​ ( y ) e_{t}=W_{t}h_{t}(y) for a caption y y .
Here, h v h_{v} and h t h_{t} are the image and text transformers, and W v W_{v} and W t W_{t} project their outputs into a shared d d -dimensional space.
Candidates are ranked by cosine similarity e ^ v ⊤ ​ e ^ t \hat{e}_{v}^{\top}\hat{e}_{t} , where hats denote L 2 L_{2} normalization.
We seek weight edits that improve this ranking on held-out pairs while keeping ImageNet zero-shot accuracy within a fixed tolerance.
A set of these edits forms a patch ; applying it produces an ordinary checkpoint with the same architecture and inference cost.

blocks.en:
The paired statistic. To guide an edit, we need to identify which parts of the shared representation favor wrong matches.
We therefore compare matched pairs with their hard negatives : the incorrect candidates with the highest similarity scores.
These candidates compete most directly with the correct match and reveal where the towers’ agreement is misleading.
For each caption y y , we collect its five highest-scoring wrong images in ℋ ⁡ ( y ) \mathcal{H}(y) ; for each image x x , we collect its 25 highest-scoring wrong captions in ℋ ⁡ ( x ) \mathcal{H}(x) .
For matched pairs 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , we define the d × d d\times d paired statistic 𝐃 \displaystyle\mathbf{D} = 𝔼 𝒫 ​ [ e ^ v ​ ( x ) ​ e ^ t ​ ( y ) ⊤ ] \displaystyle=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{P}}\big[\hat{e}_{v}(x)\,\hat{e}_{t}(y)^{\top}\big] (1) − 1 2 ​ 𝔼 y , x ′ ∈ ℋ ⁡ ( y ) ​ [ e ^ v ​ ( x ′ ) ​ e ^ t ​ ( y ) ⊤ ] \displaystyle-\tfrac{1}{2}\,\mathbb{E}_{y,\,x^{\prime}\in\mathcal{H}(y)}\big[\hat{e}_{v}(x^{\prime})\,\hat{e}_{t}(y)^{\top}\big] − 1 2 ​ 𝔼 x , y ′ ∈ ℋ ⁡ ( x ) ​ [ e ^ v ​ ( x ) ​ e ^ t ​ ( y ′ ) ⊤ ] . \displaystyle-\tfrac{1}{2}\,\mathbb{E}_{x,\,y^{\prime}\in\mathcal{H}(x)}\big[\hat{e}_{v}(x)\,\hat{e}_{t}(y^{\prime})^{\top}\big]. The first term measures agreement on matched pairs; the other two measure agreement on hard negatives, weighted equally across the two retrieval directions.
Along a unit direction u u , agreement is the product ( u ⊤ ​ e ^ v ) ​ ( u ⊤ ​ e ^ t ) (u^{\top}\hat{e}_{v})(u^{\top}\hat{e}_{t}) of the two projected embeddings.
The trace of 𝐃 \mathbf{D} is the mean similarity margin between matched pairs and hard negatives.
The eigenvalues of sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) = ( 𝐃 + 𝐃 ⊤ ) / 2 \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D})=(\mathbf{D}+\mathbf{D}^{\top})/2 decompose this margin into contributions along orthogonal directions.
A negative eigenvalue marks a direction where hard negatives agree more than matched pairs, making it a target for weight edits.

blocks.en: 3.2 Weight-Space Programming with Astra
blocks.zh: 3.2 与Astra进行重量空间编程

blocks.en:
To turn paired evidence into better retrieval, we need to choose where to edit the towers and how to change their weights.
We use Astra (GPT-6-Astra) to investigate these choices by inspecting the model, writing weight edits, and testing their effect on retrieval.
In each session , the agent operates on one checkpoint using only our harness tools; its native tools are disabled.
The prompt describes all model components and asks the agent to identify agreement and disagreement between the towers and edit their weights accordingly.
It lists the modality gap and hubness among hypotheses to investigate, while leaving the edit locations to the agent.
blocks.zh:
要将配对的证据转化为更好的检索,我们需要选择编辑塔的位置以及如何改变塔的重量.
我们用Astra(GPT-6-Astra)来调查这些选择,方法是检查模型,写出重量编辑,并测试它们对检索的影响.
在每场比赛中,代理人在一个检查点上运作,只使用我们的操纵工具;其本土工具被禁用。
提示会描述所有模型组件,并要求代理商识别各塔之间的协议和分歧并相应编辑其重量.
它列出了假设中的模式差距和中枢以进行调查,同时将编辑位置留给代理商.

blocks.en:
Inspecting weights and paired evidence. The agent has read-only access to both towers’ weights and 35,000 COCO training images [ 34 , 30 ] with five captions each.
Within fixed budgets, it can compute over the weights without gradients, inspect activations and per-head contributions, and examine 𝐃 \mathbf{D} for pairs of tower components.
We introduce 𝐃 \mathbf{D} to give the agent evidence that weights alone do not provide: which directions favor matched pairs and which favor hard negatives.
The agent determines where and how to edit the weights using this evidence.
To assess candidate edits, it receives aggregate scores on 5,000 further training images, COCO val, and a 5,000-image ImageNet proxy.
Tool definitions and budgets are given in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
察取分量相与相配相证相. 代理商只能读取两座塔的重量和35 000个COCO训练图像[34,30],每个图像有5个标题。
在固定预算范围内,它可以在不梯度的情况下计算重量,检查活化和人均贡献,并检查D\mathbf{D}对一对塔构件.
我们介绍 D\ mathbf{ D} 给代理证据, 说明权重不能提供: 哪个方向偏好匹配对, 哪个偏好硬负数 。
代理人决定使用此证据编辑权重的地点和方式.
为了评估候选编辑,它获得了5000个再培训图像,COCO val和一个5000-image ImageNet代理的汇总分数.
工具定义和预算见补编。

blocks.en:
Writing explicit weight edits. Each edit is a program that can be inspected and re-run without the agent.
These programs may scale attention heads, remove directions from heads or MLPs, add low-rank updates, apply a shared matrix to both projections, or rewrite up to four whole tensors across the two towers.
Edits must be computed in closed form from weights and training-pair statistics, using operations such as means, covariances and eigendecompositions.
Backpropagation, iterative fitting and regression to data targets are disallowed.
We statically check every code block and manually trace each final patch array to its source code; all 13 final patches pass these checks.
blocks.zh:
写入明确的重量编辑. 每次编辑都是可以在没有代理的情况下检查和再运行的程序.
这些程序可能标出注意头,从头部或MLP中去掉方向,添加低等更新,在两个预测中应用共享矩阵,或者在两个塔上重写最多可有四个完整的收分.
编辑必须采用诸如手段、协同和等操作,从加权和训练辅助统计中以封闭形式计算。
不允许反向传播、迭接和回归数据目标。
我们静静地检查每个代码块,并手动追踪每个最终补丁阵列的源代码;所有13个最终补丁都通过这些检查.

blocks.en:
Selecting the final patch. A candidate replaces the current patch only if its COCO val score is higher by more than two paired standard errors and its ImageNet proxy score drops by at most 0.5 points relative to the unedited model.
COCO test and Flickr30k test [ 60 ] are sealed: no tool can read them.
After the session ends, we evaluate the final patch once on these test sets to measure how well the edits generalize.
blocks.zh:
选择最后补丁 。 只有当其COCO val分数高于两个对齐的标准差错,且其ImageNet代理分数相对于未经编辑的模型最高为0.5分时,才替换当前补丁.
COCO测试和Flickr30k测试被封:没有工具可以读取.
在会话结束后,我们将评估这些测试集上的最后补丁一次,以衡量编辑的普及程度。

blocks.en: 3.3 TowerBridge: A Transferable Weight-Space Recipe
blocks.zh: 3.3 塔脊:可转让的重量-空间配方

blocks.en:
Nine of the 13 sessions produce projection edits that attenuate directions with negative eigenvalues of sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D}) (Sec. 4.2 ).
To apply this correction to new checkpoints without another agent session, we distill the ViT-B/32 session’s uniform shrink into TowerBridge.
In that session, the agent sums the supplied componentwise blocks to form 𝐃 \mathbf{D} , then shrinks the directions with the 128 smallest eigenvalues of sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D}) by 10% in both projections.
These directions span one quarter of the 512-dimensional space.
TowerBridge refines this correction in three steps (Fig. 2 , bottom).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate what should change in a pretrained CLIP model to improve retrieval.
We first measure the gains of Astra’s patches and where they edit, then test whether hard-negative directions should be removed or mildly attenuated.
Finally, we test whether TowerBridge transfers the resulting correction to new checkpoints without the agent.
blocks.zh:
我们评价预先训练的CLIP模型应如何改变,以改善检索。
我们首先衡量Astra的补丁及其编辑地点的收益,然后检验硬负方向是否应该去掉或轻度地去除。
最后,我们测试Tower Bridge是否将由此产生的纠正转移到新的检查站,而不需要代理。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets, Checkpoints and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集、检查站和评价

blocks.en:
Checkpoints. We run one Astra session on each of 13 CLIP checkpoints available through open_clip [ 6 ] , covering ViT-B/32, B/16 and L/14 [ 13 ] and pretraining on OpenAI’s data [ 41 ] , LAION [ 48 , 49 ] , DataComp [ 20 ] , DFN [ 17 ] and MetaCLIP [ 59 ] .
We then apply TowerBridge to these models and 8 further checkpoints, extending coverage to ViT-H/14 (Table 1 ), and to 5 dual encoders from other families.
blocks.zh:
检查点 我们通过开放的_clip[6]对13个CLIP检查站各进行一次Astra会议,涵盖Vit-B/32、B/16和L/14[13],并对OpenAI的数据[41]、LAION[48、49]、DataComp[20]、DFN[17]和MetaCLIP[59]进行预先培训。
然后,我们将Tower Bridge应用于这些模型和另外8个检查站,将覆盖范围扩大到ViT-H/14(表1)以及来自其他家庭的5个双重编码器。

blocks.en:
Datasets and metrics. We report RSUM, the sum of recall at 1, 5 and 10 in both retrieval directions, as the change from the zero-shot checkpoint.
COCO Karpathy test [ 34 , 30 ] measures retrieval improvement, while Flickr30k test [ 60 ] measures transfer beyond the COCO training pairs used to construct the edits.
We require ImageNet [ 11 ] zero-shot accuracy to drop by at most 0.5 percentage points, referred to as the accuracy guard, and evaluate compositional understanding with SugarCrepe [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据集与计量. 我们报告RSUM,在两个取回方向的1,5和10的召回总和,作为零发检查站的变化.
可可 Karpathy测试 [34, 30] 测量检索改进,而Flickr30k测试 [60] 测量转移超出用于构建编辑的COCO训练对.
我们要求ImageNet [11] 零发精度以0.5个百分点的速度下降,称为精度守备,并与SugarCrepe [25] 一起评价成分理解.

blocks.en:
Settings. COCO test and Flickr30k test are inaccessible to the agent; each final patch is evaluated after its session ends.
For TowerBridge, the rule is fixed across checkpoints and its matrices are frozen before COCO test evaluation.
We use validation splits for the analyses below and identify them explicitly.
A gain is significant when its 95% confidence interval, computed by a paired bootstrap grouped by image, lies above zero.
Details are in Sec. 3.2 and the supplement.
blocks.zh:
设置。 毒剂无法进入COCO测试和Flickr30k测试;每个最终补丁会在其会话结束后进行评估.
对于Tower Bridge来说,规则是固定在检查站之间的,其矩阵在COCO测试评价前被冻结.
我们使用验证分法进行以下分析,并明确识别。
如果以图像组合成对的靴子计算出的95%的置信间隔高于零,则收益是重大的。
详情见第3.2条和补编。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Agent-written weight edits improve CLIP retrieval. Test RSUM gains over zero-shot, with one Astra session for each model. Whiskers: 95% confidence intervals; dashed lines: means. All COCO gains are significant; Flickr30k evaluates transfer beyond the session’s feedback.
blocks.zh: 图3:代理写重编辑改进CLIP检索. 测试 RSUM 的增益超过0发,每个型号有一个Astra会话. 花哨:95%的置信间隔;虚线:表示. Flickr30k评价转移超过会议反馈。

blocks.en: 4.2 Weight-Space Edits Improve Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.2 重量空间编辑改进检索

blocks.en:
Astra’s programs improve COCO test retrieval on all 13 checkpoints, each significantly, by + 12.2 +12.2 RSUM on average (Fig. 3 ).
The gains extend to Flickr30k test, averaging + 5.8 +5.8 RSUM and reaching significance on 11 of 13 checkpoints, although no tool reports this dataset to the agent.
Every patch passes the accuracy guard, and each COCO test gain is within 1.5 1.5 RSUM of its validation gain (see the supplement).
These results show that explicit, gradient-free weight edits improve pretrained CLIP models across architectures and pretraining sources, with gains beyond the feedback used to select them.
blocks.zh:
Astra的方案改善所有13个检查站的COCO测试检索,每个检查站都显著改善,平均增加12.2+12.2RSUM(图3)。
收益扩大到Flickr30k测试,平均+ 5.8+5.8 RSUM,并在13个检查站中的11个达到重要性,尽管没有工具向代理人报告这一数据集。
每个补丁会通过精度守备,每个COCO的测试增益在其验证增益的1.5 1.5 RSUM范围内(见补充).
这些结果显示,清晰的,无梯度重量的编辑改进了跨架构和预训源的预训CLIP模型,其增益超出了用于选择它们的反馈.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Edit locations. Rows: final patches; bars: patches per site. Blue: image tower; purple: text tower. Norm: final LayerNorm bias; Block: last block.
blocks.zh: 图4:编辑地点。 行:最终补丁;条:每个站点的补丁. 蓝色:图像塔;紫色:文字塔. Norm:最终图层 Norm偏差; Block:最后一块.

blocks.en:
Paired evidence helps guide this process.
In controls on OpenAI B/16 and DFN-2B L/14 using a later harness, removing 𝐃 \mathbf{D} reduces Flickr30k validation gains by 6.3 6.3 and 1.7 1.7 RSUM, respectively.
Removing raw-weight reading has a smaller effect, 0.5 0.5 and 1.3 1.3 RSUM.
Under matched evaluation budgets, a random search over a fixed edit grammar with the same statistic also finds projection corrections, with a similar mean Flickr30k test gain ( + 5.7 +5.7 against + 5.8 +5.8 ; see the supplement).
The paired statistic thus guides weight-space programming by making these corrections accessible, and Astra uses it to construct explicit weight-editing programs.
blocks.zh:
保有证据有助于指导这一进程。
在对OpenAI B/16和DFN-2B L/14的控制中,使用后置取带,去除 D\mathbf{D} 将Flickr30k 验证增益分别减少 6.3和1.7 1.7 RSUM.
移除生重读效果较小,为0.5和1.3 1.3 RSUM.
在相应的评价预算下,对同一统计的固定编辑语法进行随机搜索也会发现投影更正,并获得类似的平均Flickr30k测试增益(+ 5.7+5.7对+ 5.8+5.8;见补编)。
因此,配对统计通过使这些校正无障碍来指导权重空间编程,而Astra则用它构建出明确的权重编辑程序.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Mild attenuation improves retrieval. (a) Removing the two leading hard-negative directions, which align with the common mean and the gap, hurts retrieval, as does centering each modality; shrinking them by 10% helps (24 CLIPs). (b) TowerBridge largely preserves gap size while reducing the spread of similarities to the other modality’s mean. Dots: 18 CLIPs; lines: medians.
blocks.zh: 图5:微缩能改善检索。 (a) 取消两个主要硬负方向,它们与共同的平均值和差距一致,会损害检索,同时将每种模式集中起来;将其缩小10%,帮助(24个CLIP)。 (b) Tower Bridge在很大程度上保持了缺口的大小,同时缩小了类似程度与另一种模式的平均值相去甚远。 点:18个CLIP;行:中位数.

blocks.en:
Although every session can edit internal components, 12 of the 13 final patches rewrite an output projection (Fig. 4 ).
All 12 construct a map from 𝐃 \mathbf{D} : 9 attenuate directions with negative eigenvalues as in Eq. ( 2 ), and 3 apply rotations.
The remaining patch edits the last vision MLP alone.
Internal edits can also provide additional gains, such as + 9.2 +9.2 Flickr30k validation RSUM beyond the projection edits on OpenAI B/16.
When reapplied as a fixed procedure, the OpenAI B/16 MLP rewrite significantly improves on TowerBridge on only one of five additional checkpoints (see the supplement).
The recurring projection correction provides the basis for TowerBridge.
blocks.zh:
虽然每个会话可以编辑内部组件,13个最终补丁中的12个会重写出一个输出投影(图4.
所有 12 从 D\ mathbf{ D} 构造一个映射 : 9 以 负等值( Eq. ( 2 ) ) 和 3 应用旋转 。
所剩补丁仅编辑了最后一个视觉 MLP.
内部编辑还可以提供额外的收益,例如+9.2+9.2 Flickr30k验证RSUM超出OpenAI B/16上的预测编辑.
在作为固定程序重新应用时,OpenAI B/16 MLP只重写了另外5个检查站之一的Tower Bridge上的重大改进(见补编).
经常性的投影修正为塔桥提供了基础.

blocks.en: 4.3 Mild Attenuation of Hard-Negative Directions
blocks.zh: 4.3 减少困难方向

blocks.en:
To understand this correction, we test whether its leading directions should be attenuated or removed.
Removing the modality gap [ 33 ] hurts retrieval in all 13 sessions, consistent with prior observations for classification [ 46 ] .
We extend the comparison to 24 checkpoints using u mean u_{\mathrm{mean}} and u gap u_{\mathrm{gap}} , the eigenvectors associated with the two smallest eigenvalues of sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D}) , which align with the common-mean and gap directions.
Removing both hurts every checkpoint, by 48.6 48.6 COCO validation RSUM on average, as does per-modality centering [ 53 ] ( − 20.2 -20.2 ); shrinking them by 10% instead improves all 24, by + 7.8 +7.8 (Fig. 5 a).
Among tested strengths, the best shrink is 10–20% on every checkpoint, and the mean gain is negative at 30% (see the supplement).
These two directions alone recover about 60% of the + 12.5 +12.5 gain from one full round.
The comparison supports retaining their useful content while reducing their influence on retrieval scores.
The modality means alone do not explain the gain: shrinking their span gains + 2.3 +2.3 COCO validation RSUM on 21 checkpoints, against + 16.1 +16.1 for TowerBridge (see the supplement).
blocks.zh:
为了理解这一更正,我们检验是否应削弱或去除其主要方向。
消除模式差距[33]会损害所有13个会话的检索,这与先前关于分类的意见一致[46]。
我们使用 u 表示 u mathrm{mean} 和 u_{\ mathrm{gap} 来将比较范围扩大到24个检查站,
拆除这两个检查站会伤及每个检查站,平均为48.6 48.6 COCO验证RSUM, 单式中心为[53](−20.2-20.2);缩小了10%,使24个检查站都有所改善,增加7.8+7.8 (图5a)。
在测试的优势中,每个检查站的最佳收缩率为10-20%,平均收益为负30%(见补充部分)。
仅这两个方向就从一整回合得到约60%的+12.5+12.5收益.
比较有助于保留其有用的内容并减少其对检索分数的影响。
该模式本身意味着不解释收益:在21个检查站里缩小其跨度收益+2.3+2.3COCO验证RSUM,而TowerBridge则增加16.1+16.1(见补编)。

blocks.en:
We then examine how the resulting TowerBridge correction changes rankings.
On held-out COCO pairs, the margin to the hardest negative widens in both directions on all 21 checkpoints, and hubness decreases (see the supplement).
The median share of text-to-image misses landing on hubs falls from 28 % 28\% to 19 % 19\% .
Meanwhile, the modality gap remains largely unchanged: its median size changes by + 0.1 % +0.1\% over the 18 checkpoints in Fig. 5 b.
Figure 6 illustrates the ranking improvement with both an agent patch and TowerBridge: a correct image replaces a hub that had attracted many unrelated captions.
This is the bridging effect: matched pairs become easier to distinguish from hard negatives while the modality gap remains largely unchanged.
blocks.zh:
然后我们来研究 由此而来的塔布里奇校正 是如何改变排名的
就被搁置的COCO对而言,所有21个检查站的负差均在双向扩大,枢纽性也有所下降(见补编)。
中位数的文本对图像失利率从28%(28%)下降到19%(19%)。
同时,模式差距基本上没有改变:在图5b的18个检查站中,其中位数变化为+0.1%+0.1%。
图6用代理补丁和TowerBridge说明排名的改进:正确的图像取代了吸引了许多无关标题的中枢.
这就是连接效应:匹配的对子更容易与硬负子区分开来,而模式差距基本上保持不变.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Correct images replace hubs. Top-3 COCO validation retrievals before and after Astra’s patch (top) and TowerBridge on a checkpoint without a session (bottom). Green: correct image; red: hub. Hub wins count captions (bubble icon) retrieving that image first. Further examples are in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 图6:正确图像替换中枢. 前3级 COCO在Astra的补丁(上部)和Tower Bridge的检查点上进行前后的验证检索(下部). 绿色:正确图像;红色:中枢. Hub 胜出数标题( 泡泡图标) 先取回图像 。 其他例子见补编。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : TowerBridge transfers the correction without the agent. (a) COCO and Flickr30k validation gains on 21 CLIPs; fresh checkpoints were downloaded after the recipe was fixed.
(b) Re-mining improves on one round while meeting the accuracy guard on all 21.
(c) COCO validation gains with fewer construction images.
blocks.zh:
图7:塔布里奇在没有代理的情况下转移校正. (a) COCO和Flickr30k对21个CLIP的验证结果;在定好食谱后下载了新的检查站。
(b) 重新采矿在达到所有21个的精确值的同时,能改进一回合。
(c) 建筑图像较少的COCO验证收益。

blocks.en: Table 1 : TowerBridge transfers to checkpoints without agent sessions. RSUM change from zero-shot. 1R, 2R: one and two rounds; other columns use 2R. IN: ImageNet top-1; SC: SugarCrepe add. Fresh: the last three checkpoints, downloaded after the recipe was fixed.
blocks.zh: 表1:塔桥向检查站的转移,不经过代理人会议。 RSUM从零发换来. 1R,2R:一发和两发;其他列使用2R. IN: 图像 净上为一;SC:取糖Crepe加入. 新鲜:最后三个检查站,在食谱定好后下载.

blocks.en: 4.4 TowerBridge Transfers Without the Agent
blocks.zh: 4.4 没有代理人的塔桥转让

blocks.en:
TowerBridge applies the same rule to each checkpoint, computing its correction from that model’s own embeddings without model-specific tuning (Sec. 3.3 ).
It improves COCO test retrieval on all 21 CLIP checkpoints, each significantly, by + 16.8 +16.8 RSUM on average (Table 1 ).
All six recalls increase on every checkpoint, with mean recall@1 gains of + 3.8 +3.8 points for image-to-text and + 2.8 +2.8 for text-to-image retrieval.
The mean Flickr30k test gain is + 6.6 +6.6 RSUM, and every checkpoint passes the accuracy guard.
blocks.zh:
Tower Bridge对每个检查站都适用同样的规则,从该模型本身的嵌入处计算校正,而不进行模型特定的调取(第3.3条)。
它改进了所有21个CLIP检查站的COCO测试检索,每个检查站平均比16.8+16.8 RSUM(表1)。
所有6个点都召回了每个检查点,平均召回@1的增益为:图像到文本+3.8+3.8分;文本到图像检索+2.8+2.8分.
平均Flickr30k测试增收为+ 6.6+6.6 RSUM,每个检查站都会通过精准守备.

blocks.en:
The 8 checkpoints without agent sessions provide a direct test of transfer.
Their gains average + 14.5 +14.5 COCO test and + 5.2 +5.2 Flickr30k test RSUM, extending to ViT-H/14 and pretraining sources absent from the sessions.
Of these checkpoints, 3 were downloaded only after the recipe was fixed; their mean COCO test gain is + 14.6 +14.6 .
These results show that applying the discovered correction does not require repeating the agent’s search on each model.
The recipe also works with other paired data: built from Flickr30k training pairs, it improves COCO validation retrieval by 8.0 8.0 – 22.2 22.2 RSUM on three checkpoints (see the supplement).
blocks.zh:
8个检查站没有办理代理手续,直接检验转移情况。
他们的平均收益+14.5+14.5CO测试和+5.2+5.2 Flickr30k测试RSUM,延伸至ViT-H/14以及未参加培训班的预训来源.
在这些检查站中,有3个是在食谱固定后下载的;它们的平均COCO测试收益为+14.6+14.6.
这些结果表明,应用已发现的校正并不需要在每个模型上重复代理搜索.
食谱还与其他配对数据相配合:由Flickr30k训练配对而来,在3个检查站改进COCO验证检索8.0 8.0 – 22.2 22.2 RSUM(见补编).

blocks.en:
The same correction significantly improves Flickr30k validation retrieval while passing the accuracy guard on 4 of 5 evaluated dual encoders from other families: EVA02-B/16 [ 52 ] , MobileCLIP-B [ 57 ] , CoCa B/32 [ 61 ] and SigLIP B/16 [ 63 ] .
For SigLIP, which lacks a vision projection, we apply S S as a linear layer after the vision encoder.
SigLIP2 [ 56 ] also improves retrieval but loses 0.70 0.70 ImageNet points, so the accuracy guard retains the zero-shot model (see the supplement).
blocks.zh:
同一更正大大改进了Flickr30k验证检索,同时通过对来自其他家庭的5个经评价的双编码器中的4个的精确防护:EVA02-B/16 [52],MobileCLIP-B [57],CoCa B/32 [61]和SigLIP B/16 [63].
对于缺乏视觉投影的SigLIP,我们应用SS作为视觉编码器后的一个线性层.
SigLIP2 [56] 还改进了检索,但损失了0.70 0.70 图像 网点,因此精度卫士保留了"零射"模型(见补充).

blocks.en:
Distilling the agent’s uniform shrink and adding our second-round refinement also improves on the original patches.
On all 13 checkpoints with sessions, TowerBridge significantly exceeds the agent’s COCO test gain, averaging + 18.2 +18.2 versus + 12.2 +12.2 RSUM.
Constructing the edit takes about 8 s for B/16 and 24 s for L/14 on one B200, including encoding and both correction rounds but excluding model loading, preprocessing and evaluation of the accuracy guard (see the supplement).
The original agent sessions took 3.6–12.1 hours each.
Once folded into CLIP’s projections, the correction yields an ordinary checkpoint with unchanged architecture and inference cost.
blocks.zh:
也改进了原来的补丁。
在所有13个设有检查站的检查站,塔桥明显超过 该剂的COCO测试收益,平均为+18.2+18.2对+12.2+12.2RSUM。
构造编辑需要约8 s的B/16和24 s的L/14在一个B200上,包括编码和两发校正弹,但不包括模型加载,预处理和评价精度守备(见补编).
最初的代理会历时3.6-12.1小时。
校正一旦并入CLIP的预测,就会产生一个普通的检查站,其结构和推论费用不变。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2 : Design choices in TowerBridge. Means over 18 checkpoints (exploratory). Default: two rounds, d / 4 d/4 directions, both towers, 5,000 images. Guard: checkpoints losing ≤ 0.5 {\leq}\,0.5 ImageNet points. † One round on 16 checkpoints, with strength selected on held-out data. ‡ B/16 OpenAI, on our expert patch.
blocks.zh: 表2:塔布里奇的设计选择。 是指超过18个检查站(勘探)。 默认为: 二发, d / 4 d/4方向,双塔相通,有5000个相机. 警卫:检查站损失0.5克,0.5克 ImageNet 点数 。 _ 在16个检查站进行一轮检查,根据搁置的数据选定兵力。 B16 OpenAI,我们的专家补丁。

blocks.en:
We test which choices make the correction effective using Table 2 and Fig. 7 b,c.
Table 2 reports means over 18 checkpoints unless noted otherwise.
blocks.zh:
我们使用表2和图7b、c来测试哪些选择使更正有效。
除非另有说明,否则表2所列检查站超过18个。

blocks.en:
Hard-negative directions drive the gain. Random subspaces of the same size give − 1.0 -1.0 COCO validation RSUM, while shrinking the most positive directions gives − 66.0 -66.0 , compared with + 16.6 +16.6 for TowerBridge.
A separate one-round comparison on 16 checkpoints finds that replacing hard negatives with random negatives reduces the mean gain by 7.7 7.7 RSUM.
A 10% shrink of as many top principal directions, chosen without pair labels, gains at most + 0.3 +0.3 on 24 checkpoints, against + 12.5 +12.5 for one round of TowerBridge (see the supplement).
The paired statistic identifies useful editing targets beyond generic perturbations of the representation.
blocks.zh:
硬负行取取取取取. 同大小的随机子空间给出了-1.0-1.0CO验证RSUM,而收缩最正方向给出了-66.0-66.0,而Tower Bridge则给出了+16.6+16.6.
对16个检查站进行单独一轮比较后发现,用随机负数取代硬负数将平均收益减少7.7 RSUM。
在24个检查站中,最多增加0.3+0.3,而一回合Tower Bridge则增加12.5+12.5(见补编)。
配对统计确定了除一般性干扰代表之外有用的编辑目标。

blocks.en:
A uniform shrink outperforms eigenvalue weighting. We test the choice justified for the bilinear margin in Sec. 3.3 under the cosine score used for retrieval.
At matched first-order gain, uniform shrinkage outperforms eigenvalue-weighted shrinkage on all 13 tested checkpoints, by 8.0 8.0 COCO validation RSUM on average, with 0.8 0.8 points less ImageNet loss.
This supports the mild, uniform correction under the deployed scoring rule as well as the constrained surrogate.
blocks.zh:
制服收缩效果优于等值加权. 我们在用于取回的余弦分数下测试3.3第3节中双线差值的合理选择。
在相应的第一订单收益中,所有13个经过测试的检查站的均匀收缩率超过均值加权收缩率,平均8.0COCO验证RSUM,减少0.8分的ImageNet损失。
这有助于根据部署的评分规则进行温和而统一的改正以及限制代用。

blocks.en:
Re-mining makes the second round effective. The first edit changes which negatives compete with matched pairs, so we compare a larger step, a second round using the original negatives, and a second round with re-mining (Fig. 7 b).
Re-mining replaces about a quarter of the negatives and gains 4.13 4.13 COCO validation RSUM over a second round using the original negatives, on average across 21 checkpoints.
It passes the accuracy guard on all 21; the larger step and stale-negative variants each fail on 13.
A third round raises retrieval further but fails the accuracy guard on 5 of the 18 ablation checkpoints, motivating the two-round recipe.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Both towers contribute; 250 images already help. Editing both towers gives + 16.6 +16.6 COCO validation RSUM, compared with + 11.9 +11.9 for image-only and + 11.7 +11.7 for text-only editing, with each variant re-mining its own negatives.
For an existing image index, folding the full metric M M into the text tower retains + 15.8 +15.8 while leaving image embeddings unchanged.
The correction also works with fewer construction images: 1,000 images give + 12.9 +12.9 RSUM and 250 give + 8.2 +8.2 (Fig. 7 c).

blocks.en:
TowerBridge outperforms KISSME-K. Table 3 compares TowerBridge with KISSME-K [ 31 ] , using the same labelled pairs and hard negatives on 8 checkpoints.
TowerBridge gains + 7.6 +7.6 Flickr30k validation RSUM against + 2.5 +2.5 for KISSME-K.

塔脊优于业绩 KISSME-K. 表3比较了TowerBridge和KISSME-K[31],在8个检查站使用同样的标签对和硬底.
TowerBridge增益+7.6+7.6 Flickr30k验证RSUM对KISSME-K+2.5+2.5.

blocks.en:
TowerBridge needs no gradient-based optimization. On OpenAI B/16, a shared map trained with gradients on the same 5,000 images gains + 38.7 +38.7 COCO validation RSUM, compared with + 29.1 +29.1 for TowerBridge; on DataComp-XL B/16 and DFN-2B L/14, the trained map is level or at most 2.2 2.2 ahead.
LoRA [ 26 ] achieves a larger gain on OpenAI B/16 ( + 46.9 +46.9 COCO test RSUM).
TowerBridge provides retrieval improvements without model-specific optimization, a held-out selection split or hyperparameter search (see the supplement).
blocks.zh:
TowerBridge不需要基于梯度的优化. 在OpenAI B/16上,经过梯度培训的共享地图在同一5000个图像上得到+38.7+38.7COCO验证RSUM,而TowerBridge则得到+29.1+29.1;在DataComp-XL B/16和DFN-2B L/14上,经过培训的地图是水平或前方最多2.2.2。
LoRA [26]在OpenAI B/16(+46.9+46.9COCO测试RSUM)上获得更大的收益.
Tower Bridge提供检索改进,而不进行模型特异性优化,一个被搁置的选择分出或超参数搜索(见补充).

blocks.en:
TowerBridge preserves overall compositional accuracy. Across 21 checkpoints, overall SugarCrepe accuracy is nearly unchanged ( + 0.06 +0.06 points): replace and swap improve by 1.1 1.1 and 1.6 1.6 points, while add decreases by 1.9 1.9 .
A constrained variant of Step 2 addresses this tradeoff in a separate four-checkpoint evaluation, retaining nearly the same retrieval gain ( − 0.2 -0.2 Flickr30k validation RSUM relative to TowerBridge) and the zero-shot add accuracy ( + 0.2 +0.2 points; see the supplement).
blocks.zh:
Tower Bridge保留了整体构成精度. 在21个检查站中,SugarCrepe的准确性几乎保持不变(+0.06+0.06分):替换和交换增加了1.1分和1.6分,而减少1.9分。
步骤2的受限变体在单独的四分点评价中解决了这种取舍,保留了几乎相同的取回收益(相对于TowerBridge的Flickr30k验证RSUM)和零发加精度(+0.2+0.2分;见补编).

blocks.en:
TowerBridge complements test-time re-ranking. On the 8 checkpoints in Table 3 , TowerBridge outperforms all evaluated re-rankers on Flickr30k validation when their reference bank comes from COCO.
With an in-domain bank, some re-rankers achieve larger gains.
For both bank sources, combining TowerBridge with each evaluated re-ranker adds 2.0 2.0 – 4.9 4.9 Flickr30k validation RSUM on average across the 8 checkpoints.

Tower Bridge补充了测试时间重排. 在表3的8个检查站,TowerBridge在Flickr30k验证中,
有了内地银行,一些重新排名者取得了更大的收益.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We showed that the directions of CLIP that favor hard negatives should be mildly attenuated rather than removed.
Our paired statistic identifies these directions, and the leading two align with the common mean and the gap.
Removing them degrades retrieval, whereas a mild shrink improves it while largely preserving the gap.
Astra, an LLM agent that can edit any component of either tower, converges on the output projections and improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 evaluated CLIP checkpoints.
We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, which improves all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints and 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families without the agent, model-specific tuning or added inference cost.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,支持硬底片的CLIP方向应当轻而易举地减弱而不是去掉。
我们的配对统计确定了这些方向,领先的两个方向符合共同的平均值和差距。
移除它们会降低检索,而温和的收缩则会改善检索,同时在很大程度上保持了差距.
Astra是一个LLM代理,可以编辑任一塔的任何组件,它集中了输出预测,改进了所有13个经评价的CLIP检查站的COCO测试检索.
我们将其反复出现的更正提炼出塔桥,改进了所有21个经评估的CLIP检查站和来自其他家庭的5个双重编码器中的4个,但没有进行特制调整或增加推论费用。

blocks.en:
Limitations. The recipe requires labelled image–text pairs and currently targets dual encoders.
Trained maps and re-rankers with an in-domain bank can achieve larger retrieval gains.
We will release code, prompts and logs.
blocks.zh:
限制。 食谱需要贴有标签的图像-文本对并目前瞄准双编码器.
训练有素的地图和有域内库的再排行,可以实现更大的检索收益.
我们将发布代码,提示和日志。

LLMs in the research. An LLM is part of the method we study: Astra (GPT-6-Astra) is the agent that inspects model weights and writes the weight edits evaluated in Sec. 4 , in the 13 sessions and in the control sessions.

TowerBridge itself is a closed-form procedure and uses no LLM.

blocks.en: A.4 Building the Correction in Other Domains
blocks.zh: A.4 在其他领域建立更正

blocks.en: A new domain poses two questions. Does the COCO-built map improve retrieval there? How much can the same rule gain when it sees the domain’s own hard negatives? RSICD pairs remote-sensing images with five captions each, and ROCOv2 pairs radiology images with one caption each. 1 1 1 Lu et al., Exploring Models and Data for Remote Sensing Image Caption Generation , IEEE TGRS, 2018. Rückert et al., ROCOv2: Radiology Objects in COntext Version 2 , Scientific Data, 2024. We evaluate both settings on the same held-out galleries of 1,093 RSICD and 1,655 ROCOv2 test images. Zero-shot RSUM averages 126.4 126.4 and 96.4 96.4 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 一个新域提出了两个问题. COCO建造的地图是否改善那里检索? 当它看到这个域的硬底片时, 同样的规则能得到多少好处? RSICD为遥感图像配对,每组有5个字幕;ROCov2为放射学图像配对,每组有1个字幕. 1 1 吕等,"遥感图像说明生成探索模型与数据",IEEE TGRS,2018. Rückert等,ROCov2: Context 第2版中的放射物,科学数据,2024. 我们在同一被搁置的1 093 RSICD和1 655 ROCOv2试验图像的画廊上评价这两个设置。 零发RSUM均分分别为126.4 126.4和96.4 96.4.

blocks.en: With no target-domain pairs, the COCO-built TowerBridge map gains 3.9 3.9 [ 2.8 2.8 , 5.1 5.1 ] RSUM on RSICD and 0.8 0.8 [ 0.2 0.2 , 1.5 1.5 ] on ROCOv2 (Table S4 ). The paired gains over the COCO-built hinge map are 1.3 1.3 [ 0.5 0.5 , 2.1 2.1 ] and 0.8 0.8 [ 0.2 0.2 , 1.4 1.4 ] RSUM, respectively. Rebuilding TowerBridge from 5,000 training images per domain, with the same rank, strengths and negative counts, raises those gains to 20.6 20.6 [ 18.2 18.2 , 23.0 23.0 ] and 12.8 12.8 [ 11.5 11.5 , 14.1 14.1 ]. All 21 checkpoints improve in both domains. All deploy two rounds on RSICD. On ROCOv2 one falls back to a single round.
blocks.zh: 在没有目标域对的情况下,COCO所建造的Tower Bridge地图在RSiCD上获得3.9 3.9 [2.8 2.8, 5.1 5.1] RSUM,在ROCOv2上获得0.8 [0.2 6.2, 1.5] (表S4). COCO所建链路图的配对收益分别为1.31.3 [0.5 0.5, 2.1 2.1]和0.8 [0.2 0.2, 1.4 RSUM]. 重建塔桥,从每个域有5 000个训练图像,等级、长处和负数相同,使这些收益增至20.6 20.6 [18.2 18.2, 23.0 23.0] 和12.8 12.8 [11.5 11.5, 14.1 14.1] 所有21个检查站在这两个领域都有所改善。 全部部署两发RSICD. 在ROCOV2上,一个倒回一发.

blocks.en: We compare two ways of fitting the hinge map on the same in-domain pairs. With its COCO-selected schedule and a 25-step fallback, hinge gains 19.6 19.6 RSUM on RSICD test and 0.4 0.4 on ROCOv2 test. The paired differences (TowerBridge minus hinge) are 1.05 1.05 [ − 1.10 -1.10 , 3.19 3.19 ] and 12.5 12.5 [ 11.2 11.2 , 13.7 13.7 ] RSUM, respectively. On RSICD validation, hinge leads by 4.1 4.1 [ 2.0 2.0 , 6.2 6.2 ].
blocks.zh: 我们比较两种方法 安装连接图 在同一个域对。 由于其COCO选定时间表和25步倒计时,RSUM在RSICD试验中收益19.6 19.6,在ROCOv2试验中收益0.4 0.4。 配对差异(TowerBridge 减轴)为1.05 1.05 [− 1.10-1.10, 3.19 3.19]和12.5 12.5 [11.2 11.2, 13.7] (原始内容存档于2013-10-12) (中文(简体) ). SUM. 在RSICD验证上,链路领先 4.1 4.1 [2.0 2.0, 6.2 6.2].

blocks.en: We next tune the hinge map separately for each checkpoint using four learning rates ( 10 − 5 , 3 × 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 , 3 × 10 − 4 10^{-5},3{\times}10^{-5},10^{-4},3{\times}10^{-4} ) at 5, 10, 25, 50, 100 and 200 steps. We maximize in-domain validation RSUM among settings that pass the guard, using the RSICD validation split or the 1,663 ROCOv2 training images outside construction. The tuned map clears the guard on all 21 checkpoints in each domain. On RSICD test its gain is close to the fixed TowerBridge rule (TowerBridge minus hinge, − 0.45 -0.45 [ − 2.65 -2.65 , + 1.80 +1.80 ] RSUM). On ROCOv2 test, TowerBridge exceeds the tuned map on all 21 checkpoints, by 7.5 7.5 [ 6.6 6.6 , 8.4 8.4 ] RSUM on average.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来用四个学习率(10 - 5, 3 - 10 - 5, 10 - 4, 3 - 10 - 10 - 4, 10 - 10 - 5), 3 - 10 - 5], 10 - 4}, 3 - 10 - 4})在5, 10, 25, 50, 100和200步分别对每个检查点分别进行校正。 我们利用 RSICD 验证拆分或 1,663 ROCov2 训练图像,在通过守护的设置中最大限度地实现域内验证RSUM 。 调制地图清除了每个领域所有21个检查站的警卫。 在 RSICD 测试中,其收益接近于固定的Tower Bridge 规则(TowerBridge 减轴,− 04.5-0.45 [− 2.65 2.65,+ 1.80 + 1.80] RSUM). 在ROCOv2测试中,塔桥超过 所有21个检查站的坐标图,平均为7.5 7.5 [6.6, 8.4 8.4]

blocks.en: Table S4 : Using a COCO-built map or rebuilding in the target domain. Mean test RSUM gains over 21 CLIPs. Guard counts models meeting the ImageNet tolerance before fallback. In-domain rows use 5,000 training images. Deployed means include the specified fallback and zero-shot when needed. The final row selects a guard-passing hinge schedule on separate in-domain validation images.

blocks.en: B Retention and Compositional Accuracy
blocks.zh: B 保留和组成精确度

blocks.en: Does a retrieval edit preserve the decisions made by the original checkpoint? We test its zero-shot classifier on images outside the ImageNet guard, then use caption foils to examine sensitivity to added objects and attributes.
blocks.zh: 检索编辑是否保留了原始检查站的决定? 我们在ImageNet守护外的图像上测试它的零镜头分级器,然后使用字幕活页来检查添加对象和属性的敏感性.

blocks.en: B.1 Retention on Independent ImageNet-V2 Images
blocks.zh: B.1 保留在独立图像网-V2上 图像

blocks.en: ImageNet-V2 supplies 10,000 new images for the same classes and the same 80-prompt classifier. 2 2 2 Recht et al., Do ImageNet Classifiers Generalize to ImageNet? , ICML 2019. On its matched-frequency split, mean accuracy changes by − 0.14 -0.14 [ − 0.26 -0.26 , − 0.02 -0.02 ] points for TowerBridge, close to the − 0.16 -0.16 on the guard set, and by − 0.27 -0.27 [ − 0.40 -0.40 , − 0.15 -0.15 ] for the fixed hinge map. With images resampled jointly across checkpoints, the paired difference favors TowerBridge by 0.13 0.13 [ 0.03 0.03 , 0.23 0.23 ] points over all 21 and by 0.21 0.21 [ 0.11 0.11 , 0.32 0.32 ] over the 15 excluded from schedule selection. One TowerBridge checkpoint loses more than half a point (B/32 OpenAI, 0.55 0.55 ), compared with four hinge checkpoints (largest loss 0.73 0.73 ).
blocks.zh: ImageNet-V2为同类和同名的80即时分类器提供一万个新图像. 2 2 Recht等,"Do ImageNet Classions Generalize to ImageNet?",ICML 2019. 在其相匹配频率分出上,平均精度变化为:-0.14-0.14 [-0.26-0.26,-0.02-0.02]取塔桥分数,接近护卫套装上-0.16-0.16;再取-0.27-0.27 [-0.40-0.40,-0.15-0.15]取入固定地链图. 将图像复制到检查站后, Tower Bridge以0.13 0.13 [0.03 0.03,0.23 0.23]的分数超过全部21分,以0.21 0.21 [0.11 0.11,0.32 0.32]的分数超过15个被排除在日程选择之外的分数. 一个塔布里奇检查站损失超过半分(B/32 OpenAI,0.55 0.55),而四个连锁检查站(损失最大:0.73 0.73.)。

blocks.en: B.2 Classification Beyond ImageNet
blocks.zh: B.2 超越图像的分类 净额

blocks.en: We evaluate the same frozen maps on 13 classification test sets unused for construction, selection or the guard. Ten cover general recognition, fine-grained classes, textures, satellite images and traffic signs. Three test distribution shifts in ImageNet (Table S5 ). For each set we use its CLIP Benchmark class names, prompts and up to 10,000 test images. 3 3 3 LAION-AI, CLIP Benchmark , https://github.com/LAION-AI/CLIP_benchmark . Intervals resample images within each set jointly across checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们在13个分类测试组上评估同样的被冻结的地图 用于建造、选择或守卫 10个覆盖普遍识别,精细分级,纹理,卫星图像和交通标志. 在ImageNet(表S5)中进行了三次试发. 每一集我们使用它的CLIP基准类名称,提示和最多一万个测试图像. 3 3 LAION-AI,CLIP基准,https://github.com/LAION-AI/CLIP_benchmark. 相互间重新模拟每集内跨检查站的图像。

blocks.en: Across the 13 sets, mean top-1 accuracy changes by + 0.07 +0.07 [ + 0.03 +0.03 , + 0.11 +0.11 ] points for TowerBridge and − 0.07 -0.07 [ − 0.10 -0.10 , − 0.03 -0.03 ] for hinge. The paired advantage is 0.14 0.14 [ 0.11 0.11 , 0.17 0.17 ] points over all 21 checkpoints and 0.19 0.19 [ 0.16 0.16 , 0.23 0.23 ] over the 15 excluded from schedule selection. On the three ImageNet shifts, the mean changes are − 0.04 -0.04 [ − 0.10 -0.10 , + 0.02 +0.02 ] and − 0.27 -0.27 [ − 0.34 -0.34 , − 0.20 -0.20 ], respectively. Building TowerBridge from 5,000 web pairs instead gives a deployed 13-set mean of − 0.03 -0.03 [ − 0.07 -0.07 , + 0.01 +0.01 ] points (Sec. C.3 ).

The 13-set mean falls by at most 0.30 0.30 points on any checkpoint. Individual tasks vary. The COCO-built correction gains 1.19 1.19 points on EuroSAT and loses 0.54 0.54 on Flowers-102. Its paired advantage over hinge has an interval above zero on seven sets, including all three ImageNet shifts, and below zero on Caltech-101 and Pets.
blocks.zh: 任何检查站的13个平均点最多为0.30个0.30分。 各项任务各不相同。 COCO所建造的校正器在EuroSAT上得分为1.19 1.19分,花102. 损失为0.540.54分. 它的对接优势在7套上拥有超过0的间隔,包括全部3个ImageNet换行,在Caltech-101和Pets上则低于0.

blocks.en: Table S5 : Classification on 13 test sets outside the ImageNet guard. Zero-shot gives mean top-1 accuracy (%) over 21 CLIPs. Method columns give changes in percentage points. Diff. is the paired difference, TowerBridge minus hinge. The final rows average the three ImageNet shifts and all 13 sets, respectively, weighting each set equally.
blocks.zh: 表S5:ImageNet卫视外出13个测试集的分级. 0射出21个CLIP以上的正高-1精度(%). 方法栏给出了百分点的变化. 迪夫,这是对的区别,塔布里奇减链条。 最后一行分别平均为3个ImageNet换行和所有13套,每套加权均匀.

blocks.en: B.3 Extending the Correction to Caption-Foil Distinctions
blocks.zh: B.3. 将校正范围扩大到说明-土壤区别

blocks.en: The default edit changes overall SugarCrepe accuracy by + 0.06 +0.06 [ − 0.10 -0.10 , + 0.23 +0.23 ] points. Replace and swap improve by 1.1 1.1 and 1.6 1.6 points, while add decreases by 1.9 1.9 . When distinguishing an added object or attribute matters, the constrained variant uses caption foils built from the construction data. In each round it selects directions that preserve the mean bilinear margin between true captions and foils (Sec. F.4 ).
blocks.zh: 默认编辑时会将总的SugarCrepe精度变化为+0.06+0.06[−0.10-0.10,+0.23+0.23]分. 替换和交换改进为1.1 1.1和1.6 1.6分,同时减少1.9 1.9分。 在区分所添加的对象或属性事项时,受限制的变体使用从构造数据中构建的字幕螺旋. 在每一回合中,它都选择在真实标题和阴茎之间保持平均双线边距的方向(Sec.F.4)。

blocks.en: Across the main 21 checkpoints, the constrained edit gains 15.9 15.9 COCO val and 6.1 6.1 Flickr30k val RSUM. The differences from the default are − 0.20 -0.20 [ − 0.40 -0.40 , + 0.00 +0.00 ] and − 0.17 -0.17 [ − 0.42 -0.42 , + 0.08 +0.08 ] RSUM. Mean add accuracy rises 0.34 0.34 [ 0.08 0.08 , 0.60 0.60 ] points over zero-shot and overall accuracy rises 1.30 1.30 points (Table S6 ). Every checkpoint improves on the default’s add accuracy and passes the guard. Changes in add accuracy from zero-shot range from − 1.1 -1.1 to + 3.4 +3.4 points. On the 15 checkpoints excluded from constraint exploration, the mean add change is + 0.45 +0.45 [ + 0.17 +0.17 , + 0.72 +0.72 ] points.
blocks.zh: 在21个主要检查站,受限编辑增加了15.9个COCO val和6.1个Flickr30k val RSUM。 与缺省相差的是−0.20-0.20 [−0.40-0.40,+0.00+0.00]和−0.17-0.17 [−0.42-0.42,+0.08+0.08]RSUM. 平均加精度比零发点高出0.34 0.34 [0.08 0.08, 0.60 0.60]分,总体精度提升 1.30 1.30分(表S6. 每个检查站都会提高默认值的准确性,并通过警卫。 增加精度的变化从零发射到−1.1-1.1到+3.4+3.4分. 在15个被排除于限制探索之外的检查站,平均增加变化为+0.45+0.45[+0.17+0.17,+0.72]分.

blocks.en: On the main paper’s four prospective checkpoints, the constrained edit gains 1.69 1.69 [ 1.41 1.41 , 1.96 1.96 ] add points over the default, with a Flickr30k val difference of − 0.23 -0.23 [ − 0.71 -0.71 , + 0.28 +0.28 ] RSUM. We repeat this comparison with five disjoint retrieval samples and the same foil set, recomputing both statistics each round. All 20 runs pass the guard, improve retrieval on both validation sets and exceed the default on add accuracy. Fifteen also reach or exceed zero-shot add accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在主要报纸的4个预期检查站上,受限编辑收益为1.69 1.69 [1.41 1.41, 1.96 1.96] ,比默认增加分数,Flickr30k val相差为-0.23-0.23 [-0.71-0.71,+0.28+0.28] RSUM. 我们重复与5个脱节取回样本和同一套取回样本的比较,每轮重算两个统计数据。 所有20跑都通过后卫,改进两个验证组的检索,并超过附加精度的默认. 15个也达到或超过零发,增加了精度.

blocks.en: For retrieval, the default uses matched pairs alone and is the rule evaluated on the sealed retrieval tests. For applications that also need caption-foil distinctions, the constrained edit uses rule-generated foils and about one extra second of construction on cached embeddings (Sec. F.4 ).
blocks.zh: 对于检索,默认仅使用匹配对并是在密封检索测试上评价的规则. 对于同样需要标题-foil区分的应用程序,受限制的编辑使用规则生成的软体和缓存嵌入上约一秒的构造(Sec.F.4.

Retrieval uses RSUM. SugarCrepe add (SC add, 95% CI) and ImageNet top-1 (IN) use points. Changes are relative to zero-shot. Bold marks the default recipe. REC is the agent-derived recipe in Sec. G.6 .
blocks.zh: 表S6:调取和SugarCrepe在部署后增加精度。 上行区平均有21个主要检查站,下行区平均有4个可能的检查站(C组,表S31)。 检索使用RSUM. SugarCrepe添加(SC添加,95% CI)和ImageNet上1(IN)使用点. 变化是相对于零发. 粗体标出默认食谱. REC是第G.6 Sec. 中由代理人衍生的配方。

blocks.en: C Transfer and Robustness
blocks.zh: C. 转让和活力

blocks.en: We first apply the fixed rule to additional encoders, including models with high starting retrieval scores. We then vary the source of the pairs, the relevance labels and the sample used for construction.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将固定规则应用于额外的编码器,包括初始检索分数高的模型. 然后我们改变对子的来源,相关标签和用于构造的样本.

blocks.en: C.1 Other Dual-Encoder Families
blocks.zh: C.1 其他双重编码家庭

blocks.en: The main paper evaluated five additional encoders. Four improve Flickr30k val retrieval significantly and pass the ImageNet guard (Table S7 ). SigLIP2 B/16 gains retrieval but loses 0.70 0.70 ImageNet points, so it retains zero-shot. Including this fallback, the five-model mean gain is 4.4 4.4 [ 3.5 3.5 , 5.4 5.4 ] Flickr30k test RSUM. EVA02 and MobileCLIP absorb S S into the existing head and bias. SigLIP uses an added linear operation after its vision encoder.
blocks.zh: 主论文评价了另外5个编码器. 四人大幅改进Flickr30k val检索, SigLIP2 B/16 增益检索但损失0. 70 0. 70 图像 网点,所以它保留了0发. 包括这个倒计时,"五型"的平均收益为4.4 4.4 [3.5 3.5, 5.4] Flickr30k测试RSUM. EVA02和MobileCLIP将S吸收到现有的头部和偏入. SigLIP在其视觉编码器后使用附加的线性操作.

blocks.en: Table S7 : The five additional encoders in the main paper. Flickr30k RSUM gains and ImageNet top-1 changes (IN, points) from zero-shot. Intervals are 95% CIs. Parentheses ( † ) show the two-round SigLIP2 B/16 edit before fallback. Its deployed change is zero on all three measures.
blocks.zh: 表S7:正文中新增的5个编码器. Flickr30k RSUM增益与ImageNet从零拍出上1个变化(IN,点). 间隔时间为95% CI. 括号 ( Q) 显示回落前的两轮 SigLIP2 B/16 编辑 。 其部署的变化在所有三项措施上都是零。

blocks.en: Does the correction still help at higher starting accuracy? We apply the same rule to MetaCLIP 2 H/14, EVA02-E/14+ [ 52 ] , SigLIP2 So400m/14 [ 56 ] and Perception Encoder Core L/14. 4 4 4 Chuang et al., Meta CLIP 2: A Worldwide Scaling Recipe , NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2507.22062. Bolya et al., Perception Encoder: The Best Visual Embeddings Are Not at the Output of the Network , NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2504.13181. We build each map from the same 5,000 COCO training images and apply it to both towers’ output embeddings. All four deploy two rounds and improve retrieval on COCO val and both Flickr30k splits (Table S8 ). The largest of the four COCO gains occurs on MetaCLIP 2 H/14. Even PE Core, starting at 486.3 486.3 COCO val RSUM, gains 8.5 8.5 . SigLIP2 So400m/14 meets the ImageNet guard with a change of − 0.03 -0.03 points.
blocks.zh: 更正是否仍然有助于提高起始准确度? 我们对MetaCLIP 2 H/14、EVA02-E/14+ [52]、SigLIP2 So400m/14 [56] 和Pepception Encoder Core L/14. 4 4 Chuang等人适用同样的规则。 Meta CLIP 2: A Worldworld Expansion Recipe, NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2507.22062. Bolya等,Perception Encoder: The Best Visual Embeddings Are not at the Exduction of the Network., NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2504.13181. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-20. 我们用同样的5000个COCO训练图像绘制出每张地图,并将其应用到两个塔的输出嵌入上. 所有四发弹都部署两发弹并改进COCO val和Flickr30k两分机的检索(表S8)。 4个COCO收益中最大的是MetaCLIP 2 H/14. 连PE Core,从486.3 486.3COCO val RSUM开始,收益8.5 8.5 . SigLIP2 So400m/14以−0.03-0.03分的变化与图像网卫视相遇.

blocks.en: Table S8 : Retrieval on four high-accuracy encoders. Each retrieval column gives the two-round gain over zero-shot in RSUM with a paired 95% CI. The ImageNet columns give original top-1 accuracy and its change in percentage points. All four edits pass the guard. PE Core uses 336-pixel images.
blocks.zh: 表S8:四个高精度编码器的检索. 每个取回列都给出了在RSUM中以一对95%CI得到的双回合取出. ImageNet栏给出了原始的顶一精度及其百分点的变化. 四相编辑皆能过卫. PE Core使用336-像素图像.

blocks.en: C.2 Retrieval Gain Across Starting Scores
blocks.zh: C.2 在整个起始分数中获取收益

blocks.en: Across 21 checkpoints, the COCO validation gain ranges from 9.8 9.8 to 29.1 29.1 RSUM and tends to be smaller at higher zero-shot scores (Pearson r = − 0.79 r=-0.79 ). Figure S1 also expresses the gain as a share of the remaining distance to 600, the maximum RSUM. The 18 checkpoints outside OpenAI pretraining recover 7.2 7.2 – 9.1 % 9.1\% of that distance and the three OpenAI checkpoints recover 11.5 11.5 – 13.0 % 13.0\% .
blocks.zh: 在21个检查站中,COCO验证收益从9.8 9.8到29.1 29.1 RSUM不等,在较高的零射分数(Pearson r = − 0.79 r =-0.79)时往往较小。 图S1还表示剩余距离为600(最大RSUM)的比重收益. OpenAI预训以外的18个检查站恢复了7.2.7.2 — — 9.1%的距离,而OpenAI的三个检查站恢复了11.5 11.5 — — 13.0% — — 13.0%。

blocks.zh: 图S1:起始分数的检索收益。 每个点是COCO val上的21个CLIP之一. (a) 小组显示在微额供资股的两轮收益。 (b) 小组除以600 600-零射入的RSUM。 钻石标记OpenAI检查站。 虚线平均是其他18个。

blocks.en: C.3 Retrieval Beyond COCO-Style Captions
blocks.zh: C.3. CO-Style标题以外的检索

blocks.en: Conceptual Captions [ 50 ] pairs each image with one web alt-text caption. On a gallery of 10,000 validation pairs, the COCO-built map improves all 13 checkpoints with agent sessions. Their mean gain is 4.1 4.1 [ 3.6 3.6 , 4.5 4.5 ] RSUM from a zero-shot mean of 366.5 366.5 . Recall@1 rises 1.2 1.2 points for text-to-image and 0.3 0.3 for image-to-text retrieval.

On all 21 checkpoints, we build the map from the same 5,000 pairs and evaluate on the other 5,000. Before fallback it gains 10.4 10.4 [ 9.6 9.6 , 11.4 11.4 ] RSUM on that gallery, compared with 3.7 3.7 for the COCO-built map (Table S9 ). blocks.en: C.4 Extended Ground Truth on COCO Test
blocks.zh: C.4 COCO测试的扩大地面真相

blocks.en: A retrieved caption can describe an image even when it is absent from the five COCO references. ECCV Caption (Chun et al., arXiv:2204.03359) adds verified matches to COCO test. Its 1,261 image queries average 17.9 valid captions, and its 1,332 caption queries average 8.5 valid images. We score the same frozen maps with the official package, whose tie handling changes standard COCO RSUM by less than 0.2 0.2 relative to our scorer.
blocks.zh: 检索后的标题可以描述一个图像,即使它没有出现在五个COCO参考文献中。 ECCV 说明 (Chun等,arXiv:2204.03359)在COCO测试中加入了已核实的匹配. 其1 261个图像查询平均17.9个有效标题,1 332个标题查询平均8.5个有效图像。 我们得到同样的被冻结的地图 官方的包裹, 其领带处理 改变标准COCO RSUM 相对于我们的分数 不到0.2 0.2。

blocks.en: All six metrics in Table S10 improve on every checkpoint. Recall@1 rises 3.3 3.3 points in both directions. Text-to-image mAP@R rises from 38.1 38.1 to 40.7 40.7 and image-to-text mAP@R from 27.3 27.3 to 29.0 29.0 . On the eight checkpoints without sessions the corresponding gains are 2.5 2.5 and 1.6 1.6 points. Thus the gain persists when multiple items can be correct for a query.
blocks.zh: 表S10中的所有6个衡量标准在每个检查站都有改进。 回顾@1 双向上升3.3 3.3分。 Text-to-image mAP@R由38.1 38.1升至40.7 40.7,图像-text mAP@R由27.3 27.3升至29.0 29.0. 在没有开庭的8个检查站,所得收益分别为2.5分和1.6分。 因此,当多个项目可以正确查询时,收益就继续存在。

blocks.en: C.5 Robustness to the Construction Sample
blocks.zh: C.5 建筑样本的坚韧性

blocks.en: We rebuild the fixed recipe on five further disjoint samples of 5,000 COCO training images. Each excludes the original sample and is shared by all 21 checkpoints. Before fallback, all 105 constructions improve both COCO val and Flickr30k val retrieval, each with a 95% interval above zero (Table S11 ). Across samples, standard deviations average 0.28 0.28 and 0.37 0.37 RSUM, below the evaluation-image standard errors of 0.78 0.78 and 0.98 0.98 . The largest within-checkpoint ranges are 1.2 1.2 and 1.5 1.5 RSUM.

Edits built on Flickr30k improve COCO val by 8.0 8.0 – 22.2 22.2 RSUM on the three tested checkpoints. blocks.en: D How the Correction Improves Retrieval
blocks.zh: D. 纠正如何改进检索

blocks.en:
TowerBridge improves retrieval while largely preserving the distance between the modality means.
We examine the directions it attenuates, then connect the resulting score changes to wider hard-negative margins and fewer retrievals captured by hubs.
blocks.zh:
TowerBridge改进了检索,同时在很大程度上保持了方式手段之间的距离.
我们审视其减弱的方向,然后将由此产生的分数变化与更大的硬负边和中枢获取的检索量减少联系起来。

blocks.en: D.1 Why Attenuate Rather Than Remove?
blocks.zh: D.1 为何不删除而予以延长?

blocks.en:
Gap removal in the sessions. All 13 agents included gap removal in their first batch of edits.
Each estimated g g , the normalized difference of the modality means, from its first crossmap call on 5,000 construction images and 25,000 captions.
It applied I − a ​ g ​ g ⊤ I-a\,gg^{\top} to both projections, testing full removal ( a = 1 a=1 ) and smaller doses between 0.25 0.25 and 0.75 0.75 ; most also tested the common mean or the plane of both means.
Full removal cost 44–112 RSUM on the 5,000 held-out training images, and every tested dose of at least 0.25 0.25 lowered RSUM.
We extend this analysis to 24 checkpoints on COCO val, using the paired statistic’s leading directions.
Removal refers to the projection before cosine normalization; re-normalizing can change the modality means again.

What the leading directions carry. To see why removal fails where a mild shrink helps, we measure the score contribution e ^ v ⊤ ​ P ​ e ^ t \hat{e}_{v}^{\top}P\hat{e}_{t} of a subspace with projector P P on COCO val, for matched pairs, random pairs and the zero-shot hard negatives, over the 21 CLIP checkpoints.
In the plane of u 1 u_{1} and u 2 u_{2} , matched pairs score almost exactly as random pairs do ( 0.100 0.100 against 0.099 0.099 ), while hard negatives score higher ( 0.119 0.119 ), on every checkpoint.
Outside the selected subspace the order is reversed: matched pairs score 0.125 0.125 , hard negatives 0.086 0.086 and random pairs − 0.025 -0.025 .
The leading plane therefore carries little pair-specific agreement.
Its coordinates instead follow how often a candidate is retrieved: the absolute Spearman correlation between an image’s coordinate and its 10-occurrence count is 0.42 0.42 for u 1 u_{1} and 0.34 0.34 for u 2 u_{2} , against 0.02 0.02 for a typical direction.

blocks.en:
Table S13 shows the corresponding retrieval behavior.
After removal, the skewness of the caption 10-occurrence counts rises from 3.39 3.39 to 5.89 5.89 , hubs take 66% of the top-10 caption slots instead of 33%, and retrieval loses 49.6 49.6 RSUM.
A 10% shrink of the same plane lowers image and caption hubness on all 21 checkpoints and gains + 7.8 +7.8 RSUM.
These measurements link the leading plane to candidate-level offsets and show that mild attenuation reduces hubness where removal increases it.
They support the ranking interpretation without isolating a causal decomposition of the gain.

blocks.en: D.3 Paired Evidence Beyond the Modality Means
blocks.zh: D.3 超越模式手段的有利证据

blocks.en:
Because the two leading directions align with the modality means, we test whether a correction built from the means alone would suffice.
The control shrinks span ⁡ { μ img , μ txt } \mathrm{span}\{\mu_{\mathrm{img}},\mu_{\mathrm{txt}}\} , with the means computed on the construction pairs, using the recipe’s rounds and strengths: 0.10 0.10 , then 0.05 0.05 after the means are recomputed on the edited, re-normalized embeddings.
It differs from TowerBridge only in replacing the d / 4 d/4 hard-negative directions with these two mean directions.
Shrinking the mean span gains 2.3 2.3 [ 1.8 1.8 , 2.8 2.8 ] COCO val and 0.9 0.9 [ 0.4 0.4 , 1.4 1.4 ] Flickr30k val RSUM (Table S15 ). The paired correction gains more on all 21 checkpoints on both datasets, by 13.8 13.8 [ 13.0 13.0 , 14.5 14.5 ] and 5.4 5.4 [ 4.6 4.6 , 6.2 6.2 ] RSUM on average. The mean span captures about 14% of the COCO gain.

由于两个主要方向与方式一致,我们检验仅靠手段进行的纠正是否足够。
控制收缩跨度为 {μ img, μ txt}\ mathrm{ span}\{\mu_{\ mathrm{img}},\ mu_{\ mathrm{txt}}\}} , 利用食谱的轮回和长处计算 : 0. 10 0. 10, 然后在重新计算经编辑, 重新规范的嵌入方式后, 0.0 0.05 。
它与Tower Bridge只在用这两个正向取而代之的d / 4 d/4硬负向时不同.
缩小平均值2.3 2.3 [1.8 1.8, 2.8 2.8]COCO val和0.9 [0.4 0.4, 1.4] Flickr30k val RSUM(表S15)。 在两个数据集的所有21个检查站,配对的校正均增加13.8 13.8 [13.0 13.0 14.5 14.5] 和5.4 5.4 [4.6 4.6 6.2] RSUM。 平均跨度占COCO收益的14%左右.

We also test whether useful corrections remain outside the mean span.

The paired hard-negative statistic thus identifies useful corrections beyond a mean-only adjustment, while excluding the mean span also reduces the gain.

blocks.en: D.4 Checking the Correction Under Cosine Retrieval
blocks.zh: D.4 检查大肠杆菌检索下的校正

blocks.en:
The theory optimizes a bilinear margin, while retrieval normalizes the edited embeddings.
To test this distinction directly, we construct a statistic from the exact cosine derivative (derived in Sec. I.5 ).
For a small metric change M = I + ε ​ E M=I+\varepsilon E with symmetric E E , replace each product e ^ v ​ e ^ t ⊤ \hat{e}_{v}\hat{e}_{t}^{\top} in Eq. ( 1 ) by G ⁡ ( e ^ v , e ^ t ) = \displaystyle G(\hat{e}_{v},\hat{e}_{t})={} sym ⁡ ( e ^ v ​ e ^ t ⊤ ) \displaystyle\mathrm{sym}\big(\hat{e}_{v}\hat{e}_{t}^{\top}\big) − 1 2 ​ ( e ^ v ⊤ ​ e ^ t ) ​ ( e ^ v ​ e ^ v ⊤ + e ^ t ​ e ^ t ⊤ ) \displaystyle-\tfrac{1}{2}\big(\hat{e}_{v}^{\top}\hat{e}_{t}\big)\big(\hat{e}_{v}\hat{e}_{v}^{\top}+\hat{e}_{t}\hat{e}_{t}^{\top}\big) Averaging G G over matched pairs and hard negatives as in Eq. ( 1 ) gives the cosine-margin derivative for fixed negatives. We use this matrix in both rounds, re-mining as usual. Across 21 checkpoints its first-round subspace overlaps that of TowerBridge by 0.92 0.92 on average (random reference 0.25 0.25 ). Both edits pass the guard throughout. The cosine-based edit differs from TowerBridge by − 0.07 -0.07 [ − 0.20 -0.20 , + 0.05 +0.05 ] COCO val and − 0.13 -0.13 [ − 0.30 -0.30 , + 0.04 +0.04 ] Flickr30k val RSUM.

Changing only the norms gives − 1.1 -1.1 , and changing both gives + 9.5 +9.5 . On these checkpoints, most of the retrieval gain is already present in the edited dot product.

blocks.en: D.5 Comparison with Centering and All-but-the-Top
blocks.zh: D.5 与中心化和全托普化的比较

blocks.en:
Centering [ 53 ] subtracts the mean embedding, and all-but-the-top [ 40 ] then removes top principal directions.
Both use unpaired mean and variance statistics.
We test them on the 24 checkpoints of Fig. 5 a, using unit embeddings of the 5,000 construction images and 25,000 captions to estimate means and directions (Table S16 ).
blocks.zh:
居中 [53] 减去平均嵌入,然后去除顶端主向.
两者均使用未加说明的平均值和差异统计数据。
我们在图5a的24个检查站进行测试,利用嵌入5 000个建筑图像和25 000个字幕的单元来估计手段和方向(表S16)。

blocks.en:
Per-modality centering subtracts each modality’s own mean; a halfway shift moves each mean toward the other while preserving their common mean; common centering subtracts ( μ img + μ txt ) / 2 (\mu_{\mathrm{img}}+\mu_{\mathrm{txt}})/2 from both.
The first two close the construction-set gap before re-normalization.
We also test means estimated on the evaluation set and the original centering score, an inner product without re-normalization.
Per-modality centering costs 20.2 20.2 [ 18.8 18.8 , 21.5 21.5 ] COCO val and 12.4 12.4 [ 10.7 10.7 , 14.0 14.0 ] Flickr30k val RSUM under cosine scoring; without re-normalization, the losses are 7.6 7.6 [ 6.2 6.2 , 8.8 8.8 ] and 6.2 6.2 [ 4.6 4.6 , 7.9 7.9 ].
No centering variant improves a checkpoint on COCO val; evaluation-set means improve 2 of 24 on Flickr30k val under cosine scoring.
Per-modality centering followed by re-normalization is also the post-hoc operation in I0T [ 3 ] .
We apply that operation to unedited OpenAI B/16 using one caption per image on Flickr30k val and evaluation-set means.
Text-to-image R@1 rises from 71.0 to 73.7, image-to-text R@1 falls from 73.2 to 69.1, and RSUM changes from 516.1 to 514.3.
This check isolates the post-hoc operation and evaluation convention; it does not reproduce I0T’s trained variant or its other checkpoints.
The direction-specific gain shows why closing the gap and improving bidirectional retrieval are separate outcomes.
blocks.zh:
模式中心减去每种模式本身的平均值; 中间移位将每种模式的平均值移动到对方,同时保留其共同的平均值; 常见的中间移位减去 (μ img + μ txt ) / 2 (\mu_{\ mathrm{img}}+\ mu_{\ mathrm{txt}} )/2 从两者中推出。
前两作在重回正轨前就收紧了建筑设置缺口.
测试还意味着在评价集和原始中心分数上进行估计,一种内部产品,没有重新正常化.
人均模式中心成本20.2 20.2 [18.8 18.8, 21.5 21.5] COCO val和 12.4 12.4 [10.7 10.7, 14.0 14.0] Flickr30k val RSUM 在余弦分数下;没有重新规范化,损失为7.6 7.6 [6.2 6.2, 8.8 8.8]和 6.2 [4.6 4.6, 7.9].
任何中心变量都不能改进COCO val上的检查点;评价设置意味着在Cosine分数下,Flickr30k val上的24个检查点中的2个。
通式中心后再进行再正态化也是I0T [3]中Hoc后操作.
使用Flickr30k val上的每个图像一个标题,
文本到图像的R@1从71.0上升到73.7,图像到文本的R@1从73.2下降到69.1,RSUM从516.1到514.3.
这种检查隔离了事后的作业和评价公约;它不转载I0T训练有素的变体或其他检查站。
具体方向的收益表明,为什么缩小差距和改进双向检索是单独的结果。

blocks.en:
For all-but-the-top, we remove D = 1 D=1 or D = d / 100 D=d/100 principal directions after centering, either separately per modality or from pooled embeddings with equal modality weight.
Every variant lowers COCO val retrieval on every checkpoint.
One round of TowerBridge instead improves all 24, by + 12.5 +12.5 RSUM.
blocks.zh:
除顶外,我们删除D=1 D=1或D=d/100 D=d/100 居中后的主要方向,或按方式单独取出,或从具有相同方式权重的集合嵌入.
每个变体都会降低每个检查站的COCO val检索率.
取而代之的是一发Tower Bridge改进了全部24发,通过+ 12.5+12.5 RSUM.

blocks.en:
Mild shrinks without pair labels. All-but-the-top removes its directions, so we also shrink top principal directions mildly, as TowerBridge does with hard-negative directions.
We shrink 2, d / 100 d/100 or d / 4 d/4 directions by 5–50%, taking them from the pooled uncentered second moment, the pooled covariance, or each modality’s covariance, and apply the result as a linear map without translation.
The best of these 36 settings gains + 2.2 +2.2 COCO val RSUM (two directions of the pooled second moment at 10%), and a 10% shrink of d / 4 d/4 directions gains at most + 0.3 +0.3 , against + 12.5 +12.5 for one round of TowerBridge at the same strength and rank (Table S16 ).
The paired statistic identifies useful editing directions beyond these unpaired mean and variance controls.
blocks.zh:
没有双子标签的Mild收缩. 全能但顶部取消了它的方向,所以我们也轻而易举地缩小了顶端主方向,就像塔克布里奇用硬负向一样.
我们把2,d / 100 d/100 或 d / 4 d/4 方向缩小了 5-50%,从集合不集中的第二瞬间,集合共变,或每个模式的共变,将结果应用为没有翻译的线性地图.
这36个设置中最好的是+2.2+2.2 COCO val RSUM(集合第二分秒点的两个方向为10%),而最多+0.3+0.3的d / 4 d/4方向增益为10%收缩,而同一强度和等级的一回合塔脊为+ 12.5+ 12.5 (表S16)。
配对统计确定了这些未放任的平均值和差异控制以外的有用的编辑方向。

blocks.en: D.6 Why Use a Mild, Uniform Shrink?
blocks.zh: D.6. 为何要用三角形、制服缩水?

blocks.en:
We also test whether the uniform step justified by the bilinear analysis remains useful under the deployed cosine score.
On 13 checkpoints, it exceeds eigenvalue-weighted shrinkage at matched first-order bilinear-margin gain by 8.0 8.0 COCO val RSUM on average, with 0.8 0.8 points less ImageNet loss.
Doubling the metric contraction from c = 0.19 c=0.19 to c = 0.38 c=0.38 on d / 8 d/8 directions loses 6.3 6.3 RSUM relative to the uniform d / 4 d/4 shrink, despite an 87% larger first-order value.
blocks.zh:
我们还检验双线分析所证明的统一步骤在所部署的同位素分数下是否仍然有用。
在13个检查站,平均比一等双线-边距增益8.0COCO val RSUM高0.8分,减少ImageNet损失。
将度量收缩从c=0.19 c=0.19到c=0.38,在d/8d/8方向上,与统一d/4d/4收缩相比,损失了6.3 6.3 RSUM, 尽管87%的一等值更大.

blocks.en:
The eigenvalue-weighted step. The weighted step acts on the same k = d / 4 k=d/4 directions as the uniform step but contracts each in proportion to its eigenvalue.
Let λ 1 ≤ ⋯ ≤ λ k < 0 \lambda_{1}\leq\dots\leq\lambda_{k}<0 be the k k smallest eigenvalues of sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D}) for the unedited model, with eigenvectors u 1 , … , u k u_{1},\dots,u_{k} , computed on the 5,000 construction images.
The metric of the weighted step is M w \displaystyle M_{w} = I − ∑ i ≤ k c i u i u i ⊤ , c i = η | λ i | , \displaystyle=I-\sum_{i\leq k}c_{i}\,u_{i}u_{i}^{\top},\qquad c_{i}=\eta\,|\lambda_{i}|, (S1) η \displaystyle\eta = c ​ ∑ i ≤ k | λ i | / ∑ i ≤ k λ i 2 , \displaystyle=c\,\sum_{i\leq k}|\lambda_{i}|\Big/\sum_{i\leq k}\lambda_{i}^{2}, with c = 0.19 c=0.19 , the contraction of the uniform step.

blocks.en:
Checkpoints have arbitrary coordinates and different dimensions, so their eigenvectors cannot be compared entry by entry.
We instead compare the responses of their subspaces to the same inputs.
Take the n = 30,000 n=30{,}000 COCO val items: 5,000 images and their 25,000 captions.
For checkpoint a a , let P a P_{a} be the n × d a n\times d_{a} matrix of unit embeddings and B a B_{a} an orthonormal basis of the subspace, with two columns for the ( u 1 , u 2 ) (u_{1},u_{2}) plane or d a / 4 d_{a}/4 columns for all of U U .
The scores Z a = P a ​ B a Z_{a}=P_{a}B_{a} give each item’s coordinates in that subspace.
We center the columns of Z a Z_{a} and let Q a Q_{a} be an orthonormal basis of their span.
For checkpoints a , b a,b , the singular values ρ 1 ≥ ρ 2 ≥ … \rho_{1}\geq\rho_{2}\geq\dots of Q a ⊤ ​ Q b Q_{a}^{\top}Q_{b} are the canonical correlations of Z a , Z b Z_{a},Z_{b} .
We measure their mean square, ρ 2 ¯ ​ ( a , b ) = 1 j ​ ∑ i = 1 j ρ i 2 ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] , \overline{\rho^{2}}(a,b)=\frac{1}{j}\sum_{i=1}^{j}\rho_{i}^{2}\in[0,1], (S2) where j j is the smaller subspace dimension.
This measure does not depend on either checkpoint’s coordinates.
For equal dimensions it is 1 1 when the subspaces compute the same functions of the inputs up to an invertible linear map and a constant; for unequal dimensions, 1 1 indicates containment of the smaller centered score space.
Across the 300 pairs of 25 CLIPs, the ( u 1 , u 2 ) (u_{1},u_{2}) plane has mean squared canonical correlation 0.74 0.74 , versus 0.03 0.03 for random planes.
The full d / 4 d/4 subspace has a much smaller separation from its random-subspace reference ( 0.42 0.42 versus 0.39 0.39 ).
The broadly shared leading plane and the more model-dependent remaining directions support transferring the rule while recomputing its subspace for each checkpoint.
Part of the leading plane’s agreement across models could come from separating images from captions. After centering the two modalities separately, its mean squared canonical correlation is 0.58 0.58 , compared with 0.02 0.02 for random planes. Agreement persists within the images alone ( 0.41 0.41 ) and within the captions alone ( 0.62 0.62 ).
