表S18报告混合分数的图像-侧平均值.

blocks.en: Table S18 : Wider retrieval margins and lower hubness. Frozen two-round edits on validation data. Each pair of columns gives the median across checkpoints (zero-shot → \to edited) and the count that improves. For gap, alignment and mixing, arrows count decreases/increases without assigning a preferred direction; uncounted checkpoints are unchanged. Definitions are in Sec. D.9 . Other families are EVA02, MobileCLIP, CoCa, SigLIP and SigLIP2; this diagnostic includes SigLIP2’s rejected edit before fallback.
blocks.zh: 表S18:检索幅度较大和中枢更低。 冻结两轮编辑验证数据. 每对柱子都给出了跨检查站的中位数(0-shot ~\去编辑)以及改进的计数. 对于缺口、对齐和混合,箭头数会减少/增加,而不指定优先方向;未计的检查站不变。 定义见D.9节。 其他家庭有EVA02,MobileCLIP,CoCa,SigLIP和SigLIP2;这种诊断包括SigLIP2在倒回前被拒绝的编辑.

blocks.en: On all 21 CLIPs, hard-negative margins widen in both directions and hubness decreases. On COCO val, the median share of text-to-image misses landing on a zero-shot hub falls from 28.1 % 28.1\% to 18.7 % 18.7\% . The initial share on OpenAI B/16 is 41.2 % 41.2\% . The two modalities still rarely mix among nearest neighbors, and matched-pair distances often increase. The matching item can move up in rank even as its absolute distance grows.
blocks.zh: 在所有21个CLIP中,硬负差从两个方向都扩大,而中枢也减少。 在 COCO val 上, 文本到图像的中位数 错过了在零发中枢上着陆, 从 28.1% 28.1% 下降到 18.7% 18.7% 。 OpenAI B/16 的初始份额为 41.2% 41.2% 。 这两种模式仍然很少在相邻的邻居之间混合,相邻相邻的相邻距离也往往会增加. 相匹配的项目即使其绝对距离增大,也可以以正向上移动.

blocks.en: The agent’s patches also lower image hubness on all 13 session checkpoints. Their gains and those of CSLS correlate with the original share of misses landing on hubs ( ρ = 0.82 \rho=0.82 and 0.95 0.95 , respectively). Section E.5 tests the two approaches together.
blocks.zh: 代理商的补丁也降低了所有13个会场检查站的图像中枢。 其收益和CSLS的收益与在枢纽上落空的原始份额相关(分别为: ^ 0.82\rho=0.82和0.95 0.95)。 E.5节将两种办法结合起来检验。

blocks.en: D.10 Retrievals Before and After
blocks.zh: D.10 前后检索

blocks.en:
Figure S3 extends the main paper’s examples with agent and recipe edits on COCO val.
Correct images move above hubs that previously attracted unrelated captions.
This pattern also appears on B/32 DataComp-XL, which had no agent session.
Across all validation captions, the agent’s B/32 patch fixes 1,723 text-to-image R@1 errors while introducing 586, so corrected rankings substantially outnumber new errors.
Misses landing on hubs fall from 39% to 23%: 6,773 of 17,353 misses before editing, versus 3,675 of 16,216 afterward.
On DataComp-XL, TowerBridge fixes 1,286 errors while introducing 554.
blocks.zh:
图S3以COCO val上的代理和食谱编辑方式扩展了主要论文的例子。
正确的图像移动到先前吸引无关标题的中枢上方 。
这种模式也出现在B/32 DataComp-XL上,后者没有代理会话.
在所有验证标题中,代理商的B/32补丁修正了1,723个文本到图像的R@1错误,同时引入了586个错误,因此纠正的排名大大超过新的错误。
在中心站落地的小姐从39%下降到23%:17 353人中有6 773人在编辑前失事,16 216人中有3 675人。
在DataComp-XL上,Tower Bridge在引入554时修正了1,286个错误.

blocks.en: Figure S3 : How a caption’s top four images change. The first three COCO val examples use Astra’s OpenAI B/32 patch. The last two use TowerBridge on B/32 DataComp-XL, which had no agent session. Green marks the labelled match and red a hub. Arrows give the match’s rank and the number of the 25,000 captions retrieving the marked hub first, before and after the edit. In row three, the patch promotes a bathroom hub.
blocks.zh: 图S3:标题头四个图像的变化。 前三个COCO val的例子使用Astra的OpenAI B/32补丁. 后两人在B/32 DataComp-XL上使用Tower Bridge,后者没有代理会话. 绿色标记标注的比赛 红色的枢纽。 箭头在编辑前及编辑后先回取标记的中枢, 第三行,补丁推广了卫生间枢纽.

blocks.en: E Further Comparisons and Practical Use
blocks.zh: E. 进一步比较和实际使用

blocks.en: We compare ways to adapt the same checkpoint using paired training images, then ask what a reference bank can add at retrieval time.
blocks.zh: 我们比较使用对等训练图像来调整同一个检查站的方法,然后问一个参考库在检索时可以添加什么.

blocks.en: E.2 A Matched Comparison on Three Checkpoints
blocks.zh: E.2 三个检查站的对应比较

blocks.en:
Table S20 places the closest alternatives side by side on three checkpoints, all built from the 5,000 construction images of TowerBridge and all passing the accuracy guard.
LoRA is retrained here on these images with the configuration of Table S21 ; its stopping step is selected from { 100,250,500 , 1000 } \{100,250,500,1000\} by COCO val RSUM among those that pass the guard.
The trained methods gain more on OpenAI B/16; the gaps are smaller on DataComp-XL B/16 and DFN-2B L/14.
The table also reports their different effects on SugarCrepe.
blocks.zh:
表S20将最接近的替代物放在三个检查站,这些检查站都是从塔布里奇的5 000个建筑图像上建造的,并且都经过精确警卫。
LORA在这里重新对这些图像进行训练,配置为表S21;它的止步从{100,250,500,1000}}{100,250,500,100}{由COCO val RSUM从通过后卫的人中选出.
经培训的方法在OpenAI B/16上获得更多;在DataComp-XL B/16和DFN-2B L/14上差距较小.
该表还报告了它们对SugarCrepe的不同影响.

blocks.en:
LoRA uses four COCO val and four ImageNet evaluations to choose its stopping step, and its final step fails the accuracy guard on both B/16 checkpoints.
On prepared inputs, training and these evaluations take 394–1,630 s per checkpoint, excluding the zero-shot reference evaluation.
Construction and the shared original/edited guard pass take 63–243 s for TowerBridge; training alone takes 142–662 s for LoRA, against 8–27 s for constructing TowerBridge.
These H200 measurements exclude loading and preprocessing, which are included in the separate deployment study of Sec. F.7 .
LoRA timings come from one run per checkpoint, with OpenAI B/16 sharing the GPU during part of training.
For TowerBridge, construction times are medians of three runs on an otherwise idle GPU, and the guard is timed once.
blocks.zh:
LORA使用4个COCO val和4个ImageNet评价来选择它的停止步骤,其最后步骤在B/16两个检查点上都未能达到准确的警戒.
在准备的投入方面,培训和这些评价每个检查站需要394-1 630 s,不包括零镜头参考评价。
建筑和共用原始/编辑的警卫通行证为塔桥63 – 243 s;仅培训为洛拉142 662 s,建造塔桥8 – 27 s。
这些H200测量不包括装入和预处理,这些都列入Sec.F.7.的单独部署研究.
LORA计时来自每个检查站运行一次,OpenAI B/16在部分训练期间共享GPU.
对于Tower Bridge来说,建造时间是三跑的中位数,在原本闲置的GPU上,而后卫被定时一次.

blocks.en: E.5 Reference Banks and Re-ranking

blocks.en:
Re-ranking corrects candidate scores at retrieval time, while TowerBridge changes the representations that produce those scores.
Table 3 compares these approaches on the same eight checkpoints as KISSME-K.
Each reference bank contains 5,000 training images and their 25,000 captions, sampled from COCO or Flickr30k.
The COCO bank uses Karpathy restval images for the session checkpoints and the construction subset for the three fresh checkpoints; the Flickr30k bank uses its training split.
The banks contain no evaluation images.
TowerBridge uses pair identities during construction. CSLS and QB-Norm use unpaired bank scores at application. NNN and DN also use labelled bank folds to set their parameters. In text-to-image retrieval the reference queries are bank captions. In image-to-text retrieval they are bank images. Choosing the re-ranking parameters. CSLS uses k = 50 k=50 neighbors and QB-Norm uses temperature parameter β = 50 \beta=50 ; the QB-Norm rows in Table 3 use dynamic inverted softmax (DIS).
These values were chosen on COCO val of OpenAI B/16 and then held fixed across checkpoints, so that comparison uses development feedback for these baselines.
NNN chooses its subtraction strength and neighbor count separately for each retrieval direction, checkpoint and bank using five folds of the labelled bank, with recall@1 as the selection objective.
Its grid is α ∈ { 0.25 , 0.375 , … , 1.5 } \alpha\in\{0.25,0.375,\ldots,1.5\} and k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , … , 512 } k\in\{1,2,4,\ldots,512\} .
DN subtracts λ \lambda times the corresponding bank mean from each unit embedding and scores their inner product without re-normalization.
It selects λ ∈ { 0 , 0.05 , … , 1 } \lambda\in\{0,0.05,\ldots,1\} by RSUM on the same bank folds.
No parameter is chosen on Flickr30k val or on either test set.

blocks.en:
Combining the edit with re-ranking. For a combined method, queries, candidates and the reference bank all use the edited embeddings.
Table S22 reports the gain from adding TowerBridge to each re-ranker with the same bank source.
Every pooled Flickr30k val contrast is positive, ranging from + 1.95 +1.95 to + 4.90 +4.90 RSUM, which gives the rounded + 2.0 +2.0 – + 4.9 +4.9 range in the main paper.
These are means across checkpoints, rather than a claim that every individual checkpoint improves under every combination.
CSLS, QB-Norm and NNN retain bank-dependent candidate statistics; DN needs only the two bank means, so a full reference bank need not remain available at inference.
DN subtracts these means after unit normalization and then uses an inner product; moving the translation into a pre-normalization head bias would change that score in general.
TowerBridge folds a linear map into the existing projections, and its gains remain useful when these score corrections are added.

每个集合的Flickr30k val对比都是正数,范围从+1.95+1.95到+4.90+4.90 RSUM,这给出了正文中四舍五入的+2.0+2.0–+ 4.9+4.9的范围.
这些都是跨越检查站的手段,而不是声称每个检查站在各种组合下都有改进。
CSLS,QB-Norm和NNN保留了依赖银行的候选统计数据;DN只需要两个银行手段,因此在推论中不需要保留一个完整的参考银行.
DN在单位正常化后减去这些手段,然后使用内出产;将译出为正态化前头部偏差会改变一般分数.
Tower Bridge将一幅线性地图折叠到现有的预测中,当这些分数校正后,其收益仍然有用.

After the remaining 250 steps, the advantage is + 0.45 +0.45 [ − 0.23 -0.23 , + 1.12 +1.12 ] over three seeds, indicating that continued fine-tuning recovers much of the same gain.

blocks.en: F.1 The Two-Round Recipe

blocks.en:
The procedure below uses the notation of main Sec. 3 .

blocks.en: F.2 Development and Application

blocks.en:
Absence of hyperparameter search refers to applying the completed recipe.
A second-round pilot used B/16 OpenAI, DataComp-XL and LAION-2B; B/32 OpenAI; and L/14 OpenAI and DFN-2B, with 5,000 COCO restval construction images and the ImageNet 5k proxy.
The schedule and controls were then fixed before evaluation on the common training construction set.
All 18 original ablation checkpoints had appeared in earlier one-round analyses; the first five without sessions are therefore not prospective for development.
Of the 21 CLIPs, only the three fresh checkpoints were named and downloaded after the completed rule was fixed (Table S23 ).
blocks.zh:
没有超参数搜索是指应用已完成的配方。

随后,在对共同培训建设进行评价之前,确定了时间表和控制。
所有18个最初的通关检查站都出现在早先的一轮分析中;因此,前五个没有开庭的检查站没有发展前景。
在21个CLIP中,只有三个新的检查站在完成的规则确定后被命名和下载(表S23)。

blocks.en: Table S23 : Which data determine each decision? The three prospective checkpoints were downloaded after the rule was fixed. Test retrieval is measured after the edits are frozen. Full ImageNet validation accuracy determines deployment. Independent retention is measured on ImageNet-V2 and 13 further test sets (Sec. B ).
blocks.zh: 表S23:哪些数据决定每项决定? 三个可能的检查站是在规则确定后下载的。 测试检索在编辑被冻结后进行测量. 完整的图像网验证精度决定了部署. 在ImageNet-V2和另外13套测试(Sec.B.)上测量独立留存.

blocks.en: F.3 The Accuracy Guard
blocks.zh: F.3 准确警卫队

blocks.en:
The deployment guard compares edited and zero-shot top-1 accuracy on all 50,000 ImageNet validation images, using 80 prompts per class.
An edit passes if its loss is at most 0.5 points.
The fixed order is two rounds, otherwise one round, otherwise zero-shot; it uses no retrieval scores.
All 21 original CLIP constructions deploy two rounds.
Neither the two-round nor the one-round edit passes for SigLIP2 B/16, which retains zero-shot (Sec. C.1 ).
The reported ImageNet changes measure this same deployment constraint; Sec. B evaluates retention independently on ImageNet-V2 and on 13 further classification sets.

如果损失最多为0.5分,则编辑通过。

所有21个最初的CLIP建筑都部署了两发.
SigLIP2 B/16的两轮和一轮编辑通行证均不保留0发(Sec.C.1.
所报告的ImageNet更改测量了同样的部署限制; Sec. B在ImageNet-V2和另外13个分类集上独立评价保留.

blocks.en:
A retrospective split-half check. A fixed split places 25 images per class in each half (seed 0).
Selecting on either half deploys both rounds for all 21 CLIPs; opposite-half mean changes are − 0.15 -0.15 and − 0.16 -0.16 points, with worst loss 0.48 0.48 .
The hinge map deploys all edits in one direction, with two opposite-half losses of 0.56 0.56 and 0.55 0.55 ; swapping halves rejects those two edits.
This is a partition-stability check on previously examined data; independent retention is measured in Sec. B .

这是对以前检查过的数据进行分区稳定性检查;独立保留在Sec.B.中进行测量。

blocks.en:
The guard in agent sessions. During a session, the test tool reports the ImageNet change on a fixed subset of 5,000 validation images, and the rule for replacing the incumbent applies the 0.5-point threshold to this proxy (Sec. H ).
The ImageNet changes of all 13 final patches in Table S26 were measured after the sessions on the full validation set and range from − 0.48 -0.48 to + 0.67 +0.67 points.
All 13 final patches pass the full-set check.

blocks.zh: 第一轮之后,21%的文字对图像负数和26%的图像对文本负数的身份会发生变化. 再开采产生第二个子空间,平均相重叠为0.82 0.82与第一个子空间相重叠,而负数被固定时为0.97 0.97 (Sec. I. 4. )。 更新负值收益4.13 4.13 [3.64 3.64, 4.64 4.64] COCO val和1.33 1.33 [0.74 0.74, 1.97 1.97] Flickr30k val RSUM 相对于固定负值. 平均糖脂加成损失也从一回合后5.3 5.3分降至两回合后1.9 1.9分。 只有检索比较使第二轮的其余部分固定不变。

blocks.en: The main ablations (Table 2 , 18 checkpoints) use a seeded random orthonormal basis for the random-subspace control and the d / 4 d/4 largest eigenvalues for the positive-direction control. A third round adds a 0.05 0.05 shrink with fresh negatives. For the data-size ablation we draw images without replacement and retain all five captions per image. A single draw of 250 or 1,000 images gives 8.2 8.2 or 12.9 12.9 COCO val RSUM before fallback. At 1,000 images, 12 of 18 pass the guard, compared with all 18 at 5,000.
blocks.zh: 主要活化(表2,18个检查站)采用种子随机正态基础进行随机-子空间控制并使用d / 4 d/4最大正向活化值. 第三轮增加了0.05 0.05收缩带新鲜负片. 对于数据大小的缩小,我们绘制图像时不更换,并保留每个图像的所有五个标题。 一幅由250或1000个图像组成的一幅画在倒回前给出了8.2 8.2或12.9 12.9 COCO val RSUM. 在1000个图像中,18个中12个通过后卫,而所有18个都是5000个.

blocks.en: We also compare procedures after fallback using the same three draws per size (seeds 700–702) on all 21 checkpoints. At 250 images, COCO val gains are 4.8 4.8 for TowerBridge, 1.4 1.4 for 50-step hinge and 7.6 7.6 for hinge with a 25-step fallback. At 1,000 images the gains are 10.6 10.6 , 7.4 7.4 and 13.1 13.1 . The fallback hinge schedule leads on COCO at both sizes. On Flickr30k val its gains ( 2.2 2.2 and 4.3 4.3 ) are close to those of TowerBridge ( 1.9 1.9 and 4.4 4.4 ), with both paired intervals including zero. The 50-step hinge gains 0.1 0.1 and 2.3 2.3 on Flickr30k val.
blocks.zh: 我们还对所有21个检查站的倒置程序进行对比,每处面积用同样的三道取出(种子700-702)。 在250个图像中,COCO的值收益是:TowerBridge为4.8 4.8;50步链接为1.4 1.4;25步回落的链接为7.6 7.6。 在1 000幅图像中,收益为10.6 10.6、7.4 7.4和13.1。 13.1 (中文(简体) ). 倒计时会同时显示COCO的进度 在Flickr30k val上,其收益(2.2 2.2和4.3 4.3)接近于Tower Bridge(1.9和4.4 4.4),两者的对接间隔为零。 50步连结Flickr30k val的0.1和2.3.

blocks.en: Two rows of Table 2 use separate controls. On 16 checkpoints, a one-round correction gains 3.4 3.4 COCO val RSUM with random negatives and 11.0 11.0 with hard negatives. Both choose strength on held-out training pairs under the guard and include fallbacks. The paired difference is 7.7 7.7 RSUM. On OpenAI B/16, the PLS, CCA and Procrustes row ( ‡ \ddagger ) measures the incremental effect of a rank-8 fit on the earlier expert patch (R in Table S26 ).
blocks.zh: 表2的两行使用单独的控制. 在16个检查站,一个一回合的更正增加了3.4.3.4COCO val RSUM,随机负数和11.0 11.0硬负数。 两人都选择了在后卫下被搁置的训练对并包括后退. 配对差异为7.7 7.7 RSUM. 在OpenAI B/16上,PLS,CCA和Procrustes行(\\\ddagger )测量了8级相适应于更早的专家补丁(表S26中的R)的递增效果.

blocks.en: F.7 Construction and Deployment Time
blocks.zh: F.7 建造和部署时间

blocks.en: From prepared inputs on one B200, TowerBridge encodes 5,000 images and 25,000 captions, mines negatives, computes both maps and folds them into the projections. OpenAI B/16 and L/14 take 7.92 and 23.60 s on the first pass (7.21 and 22.44 s, medians of seven further runs). These are the construction times in the main paper. Model loading, preprocessing and guard evaluation are timed separately below.
blocks.zh: Tower Bridge从一个B200上准备的投入中编码出5 000个图像和25 000个字幕、地雷底片、计算出地图并将其折叠入预测中。 OpenAI B/16和L/14首发取道7.92和23.60 s(7.21和22.44 s,中位数为再跑7次). 这是主要报纸上的建筑时代。 型号加载、预处理和警卫评价在下面单独定出时间。

blocks.en: Table S25 follows deployment from raw files on an idle H200. Overlapping loading with encoding gives totals of 75 s for B/16 and 252 s for L/14. With stages run sequentially, the totals are 93 and 270 s, of which the guard accounts for 78% and 85%. The original, one-round and two-round models share an encoder pass because only their outputs differ. Scoring all three takes 0.02 s. Mining and computing the maps take about 0.2 s. These measurements use a warm file cache. A cold-cache B/16 run on a shared GPU took 153 s. Internal encoder edits require fresh features for the guard.
blocks.zh: 表S25是根据闲置的H200上的原始文件部署的。 与编码相重叠的加载使B/16的加载总量为75秒,L/14的加载总量为252秒。 由于各阶段相继运行,共计93个和270个s,其中警卫占78%和85%。 最初的一回和两回的模型共用一个编码器通过,因为只有它们的输出不同. 3个都需0.02 s. 采矿和计算 地图需要0.2 s. 这些测量使用一个温暖的文件缓存. 一个共享的GPU上的冷卡片 B/16跑取了153 s. 内部编码器编辑需要守护者的新功能.

blocks.en: On cached embeddings the 50-step hinge fit takes 0.41/0.46 s on B/16 and L/14, compared with 0.05/0.07 s for TowerBridge (three warmed runs on an idle H200). Substituting these fitting times into the same deployment stages changes the estimated total by less than 0.5 s. The 200-step InfoNCE fit takes 0.9/1.1 s and per-checkpoint schedule selection takes 62/84 s. The fixed hinge schedule skips that selection. The original agent sessions took 3.6–12.1 hours each.
blocks.zh: 在缓存嵌入时,50步链合用B/16和L/14上的0.41/0.46 s,而Tower Bridge则需要0.05/0.07 s(在闲置的H200上有3个暖跑)。 将这些时间替换为相同的部署阶段,将使估计总数变化不到0.5秒。 200步的InfoNCE配置需要0.9/1.1 s,每个检查点时间表的选择需要62/84 s. 固定的按键时间表跳过该选择 。 最初的代理会历时3.6-12.1小时。

blocks.en: G From Agent Exploration to a Reusable Correction
blocks.zh: G 从代理勘探到可再利用的更正

blocks.en: The B/32 session produced a short program that shrinks hard-negative directions in both projections. We trace how that edit recurs across sessions, how our refinement transfers it to new models, and what the agent found when it also edited the encoders.
blocks.zh: B/32会场产生了一个短节目,缩小了两个预测中的硬负向. 我们追踪该编辑如何在会话中反复出现,我们的完善如何将它转移到新的模型,以及代理在它同时编辑编码器时发现了什么.

Retrieval columns show gains or paired differences on COCO test 5k and Flickr30k test 1k. ∘ The image-grouped 95% CI includes zero; other retrieval differences exclude zero. Table S26 gives the 13 sessions’ test results: mean gains of + 12.2 +12.2 COCO RSUM and + 5.8 +5.8 Flickr30k RSUM, significant on 13 and 11 checkpoints, respectively.
Twelve final patches rewrite a projection using 𝐃 \mathbf{D} : nine attenuate negative directions and three rotate the towers.

blocks.en: G.2 From Agent Sessions to a Fixed Recipe
blocks.zh: G.2 从代理会话到固定食谱

blocks.en: The B/32 program chose a uniform 10% shrink over the lowest quarter of directions. On the 13 checkpoints with sessions, this one-round rule gains 13.7 13.7 COCO val RSUM. Adding our fixed second round yields 18.2 18.2 COCO test RSUM, compared with 12.2 12.2 for the original patches. Every paired test difference favors TowerBridge (Table S32 ).
blocks.zh: B/32计划在最低方向选择了10%的制服收缩. 在13个设有会议检查站的检查站,这一轮规则取得了13.7 13.7 COCO val RSUM。 加上固定的第二轮,COCO测试RSUM的产量为18.2 18.2,而原来的补丁为12.2 12.2。 每对测试差异偏好Tower Bridge(表S32).

blocks.en: Search without the agent. We give two searches the same statistic, evaluation budgets and selection rule as the sessions. Their fixed grammar contains about 4,900 candidates per checkpoint, including spectral projection edits, rotations, mean and gap edits, and head scaling. The agent can also rewrite MLPs.
blocks.zh: 搜索没有代理。 我们进行两次搜索,与会议统计、评价预算和甄选规则相同。 他们的固定语法包含约4900名每个检查点的候选人,包括光谱投影编辑,旋转,平均和间隙编辑,以及头部缩放等. 该代理还可以重写MLP.

blocks.en: Over three seeds, uniform random search gains 12.8 12.8 COCO val and 6.3 6.3 Flickr30k val RSUM, compared with 12.0 12.0 and 5.5 5.5 for the agent. The Flickr30k test means before fallback are 5.7 5.7 and 5.8 5.8 , respectively. All 39 random-search patches include a projection edit derived from sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D}) , and 24 use the negative-direction shrink family seen in nine agent patches. The full ImageNet guard accepts all 13 agent patches and 34 of the 39 random-search patches. Reverting the other five gives random-search gains of 10.9 10.9 COCO val and 5.4 5.4 Flickr30k val RSUM. Ranking candidates by first-order margin instead favors large strengths, returns zero-shot on seven checkpoints and gains 7.5 7.5 and 4.0 4.0 on those validation sets. Both searches illustrate how the supplied statistic makes the projection correction accessible. The B/32 program specifies the particular shrink from which TowerBridge was built.
blocks.zh: 超过3个种子,统一随机搜索得到12.8 12.8 COCO val和 6.3 6.3 Flickr30k val RSUM,而该剂为 12.0 12.0和 5.5 5.5. Flickr30k测试表示倒计时前, 所有39个随机搜索补丁包括从 sym \ (D)\ mathrm{ sym} (\ mathbf{ D}) 得到的投影编辑, 以及24个使用在 9个代理补丁中看到的负向收缩家族. 完整的ImageNet后卫接受所有13个代理补丁和39个随机搜索补丁中的34个. 还原另外五个,随机搜索收益为10.9 10.9 COCO val和5.4 5.4 Flickr30k val RSUM。 以一等分数排名候选人的优势大,7个检查站的成绩为零,这些鉴定组的成绩为7.5和4.0 4.0。 两次搜索都说明所提供的统计数据如何使投影更正便于查阅。 B/32方案规定了Tower Bridge从中建造的特定收缩.

blocks.en: G.3 Edits Within the Encoders
blocks.zh: G.3 编码器内的编辑

blocks.en:
Encoder edits can provide gains beyond the projection correction on an individual model.
On OpenAI B/16, they contribute most of the Flickr30k validation improvement, adding + 9.2 +9.2 RSUM beyond the projection edits; on L/14 DFN-2B, they add + 0.2 +0.2 (Fig. S4 c).
A later-harness B/16 session tests its head choice with its own controls: reducing L9H9 helps, increasing it hurts, and reducing L9H2 has little effect (panel d).
The final B/16 patch halves the vision heads L11H6 and L9H9; that later session also selects L9H9.
Panel b compares these heads with our earlier artifact-token analysis, whose results were withheld from the prompt.
The prompt supplied the artifact-token hypothesis; the sessions selected the particular heads and tested their retrieval effects.
Section G.7 tests whether the MLP rewrite, and a head correction from a control session, transfer as fixed procedures.
blocks.zh:
编码器编辑可以在单个模型上的投影修正之外提供收益.
在OpenAI B/16上,他们贡献了Flickr30k验证改进的大部分内容,在预测编辑后再增加+9.2+9.2 RSUM;在L/14 DFN-2B上,他们还增加了+0.2+0.2(图S4 c.
一个后发性B/16会话用自己的控制测试头部选择:减少L9H9帮助,增加伤害,并减少L9H2的作用很小(palel d).
最终的B/16补丁将视觉头像L11H6和L9H9减半;后会话也选择了L9H9.
b 小组将这些头同我们早先的人工罐子分析作一比较,分析结果没有及时作出。
该快报提供了按出文物的假说;会话选择了特定的头并测试了它们的取回效果.
G.7节检验MLP是否重写,以及控制会话的头部校正,转录为固定程序.

blocks.en: G.4 The Contribution of Paired Evidence
blocks.zh: G.4 确凿证据的贡献

blocks.en:
To distinguish the roles of weight access and paired evidence, we repeat sessions with either raw-weight reading or 𝐃 \mathbf{D} removed.
Table S27 reports these controls on OpenAI B/16 and DFN-2B L/14 using a later harness, comparing the arms within each checkpoint.
The harness is fixed within each comparison; differences from the original sessions also reflect harness changes and do not isolate session-to-session variability.
blocks.zh:
为了区分重量访问和对等证据的作用,我们重复了会议,要么是原始重量读取,要么是删除 D\ mathbf{D} 。
表S27报告,OpenAI B/16和DFN-2B L/14的这些管制是使用后置取用,比较每个检查站的武器。
在每次比较中都固定了带子;与原会话的区别也反映了带子的变化,并不孤立会话到会话的变化.

blocks.en: Table S27 : Agent controls under the later harness. FULL: standard session; NOW: no weight reading (the server applies edits named by the agent); NOD: no 𝐃 \mathbf{D} or crossmap . Rows give RSUM gains from zero-shot or named contrasts with 95% CIs. Each B/16 arm has two sessions; L/14 has two FULL and one each NOW/NOD. Pooled contrasts average checkpoints with a joint image-grouped bootstrap. Test scores follow completed sessions.
blocks.zh: 表S27: 后端系带下的特工控制. FULL:标准会话;NOW:没有重读(服务器应用由代理商命名的编辑);NOD:没有D\mathbf{D}或交叉映射. 由零射出或被命名为与95%CI的对比而得到RSUM的增益. B/16臂各有两会;L/14各有两会全能L,NOW/NOD各有一次. 组合式的检查点与联合图像组合的靴子形成对比。 测试分数跟随完成的会话.

blocks.en:
Removing 𝐃 \mathbf{D} costs more than removing weight reading on both models: pooled losses of 4.0 4.0 versus 0.9 0.9 Flickr30k val RSUM and 10.3 10.3 versus 2.5 2.5 COCO val RSUM.
Weight access adds 2.5 2.5 COCO val RSUM on each checkpoint, but neither Flickr30k test contrast resolves an additional benefit (Table S27 ).
On Flickr30k val, its B/16 effect lies within the ± 2 \pm 2 RSUM band of no detectable effect; the L/14 effect meets our criterion.
blocks.zh:
删除 D\ mathbf{ D} 成本超过去除两个模型的重量读取: 集合损失 4.0 4.0 相对于 0.9 Flickr30k val RSUM 和 10.3 10.3 对 2.5 COCO val RSUM 。
但Flickr30k测试结果都无法解决额外好处(表S27)。
在Flickr30k val上,它的 B/16 效应位于 ± 2 \pm 2 RSUM 带内,没有可探测效应;L/14 效应符合我们的标准.

blocks.en:
Neither B/16 session without 𝐃 \mathbf{D} constructs a hard-negative statistic.
One aligns projections with matched pairs alone; the other finds an encoder edit that does not transfer (Sec. G.7 ).
Paired evidence is the stronger contributor within this workflow, and the fixed recipe makes it usable without another session.
blocks.zh:
没有 D\ mathbf{ D} 的 B/16 会话都无法构建硬负统计 。
一个只将预测与匹配对对对对对对;另一个则找到不传输的编码器编辑(Sec. G. 7)。
保有的证据是本工作流程中更强大的贡献者,固定的食谱使得它不用另一会就可以使用.

blocks.en: G.5 A Fixed Expert Recipe as a Reference
blocks.zh: G.5 固定专家食谱作为参考

blocks.en:
Table S26 also compares the sessions with a fixed expert recipe (R), consisting of four closed-form components assembled on OpenAI B/16 in about 2.5 days and instantiated on other checkpoints by the same rules.
These components suppress vision-specific writing directions, rank heads using text descriptions, remove artifact-token reads from the selected heads, and filter the output projections.
One component, a projection filter, came from an earlier Astra session, so this is a reference for fixed-rule transfer rather than a purely human baseline.
The agent’s model-specific patches outperform this recipe on COCO test on 12 of 13 checkpoints, by + 8.2 +8.2 RSUM on average.
On OpenAI B/16, where the reference recipe was developed, the difference is not significant.
blocks.zh:
表S26还将会议与固定的专家配方(R)进行比较,该配方由约2.5天后在OpenAI B/16上组装并按同一规则在其他检查站即兴播放的四个封闭式组件组成。
这些组件会压制特定视觉的写取方向,用文字描述来排列头,从所选头去掉文物脚本读取,并过滤出输出预测.
一个组件,即投影滤波器,来自早先的Astra会话,所以这是固定规则转移的参考,而不是纯粹的人类基线.
在13个检查站中的12个检查站进行COCO测试时,代理商的模型专用补丁平均比这种配方多出8.2+8.2RSUM。
在OpenAI B/16上,参考食谱是在其中被开发的,区别不大.

blocks.en: G.6 Agent Discovery with the Additional Objective
blocks.zh: G.6 具有额外目标的特工发现

blocks.en:
Four sessions receive 𝐃 add \mathbf{D}_{\mathrm{add}} and a held-out add check.
Each meets both goals on its own checkpoint, gaining + 10.0 +10.0 to + 11.9 +11.9 COCO val RSUM and + 1.0 +1.0 to + 2.3 +2.3 points on the held-out add check, using different patches.
The recurring components are a protection subspace (4 of 4), a rotation of one tower (3 of 4), and metric reweighting (2 of 4).
We distill these components with the sessions’ median constants and freeze the recipe before scoring the fresh checkpoints.
This recipe gains + 4.6 +4.6 COCO val RSUM on the deployed rows and fails the accuracy guard on two of four checkpoints.
For this additional objective, directly constraining the paired-statistic correction transfers more effectively than the shared components extracted from these sessions.

blocks.en: G.7 Transfer of Encoder Edits
blocks.zh: G.7 编码器编辑器的传输

blocks.en:
Some encoder edits give substantial gains in individual sessions (Fig. S4 c).
To determine whether they should also enter a transferable recipe, we reapply the OpenAI B/16 session’s largest encoder edit with its constants fixed.
It rewrites the last vision MLP’s output matrix by mapping its contribution into embedding space, attenuating directions that favor hard negatives in proportion to their eigenvalues, and mapping back.

一些编码器编辑器在单个会话(图S4c)中给予很大收益.
为了确定它们是否也应该输入可转移的食谱,我们重新应用OpenAI B/16会议的最大编码器编辑,并固定其常数。
它通过绘制其嵌入空间的贡献图来改写MLP的最后一个视觉输出矩阵,减轻那些按其等值比例偏好硬负数的方向,并绘制回图。

On each of five further checkpoints, we recompute T T , 𝐃 mlp \mathbf{D}_{\mathrm{mlp}} and the rewrite from that checkpoint’s own weights and construction pairs, keeping the strength 0.75 0.75 fixed.
An additional gain counts when DEEP+TB − - TB has a confidence interval above zero and passes the accuracy guard; the transfer criterion requires four of five checkpoints.

blocks.en:
Transfer of a head-editing procedure. The B/16 OpenAI session without 𝐃 \mathbf{D} produces a last-block patch that gains + 8.8 +8.8 Flickr30k val RSUM on its source model.
It combines a reflection of L11H0’s output, a value-bias shift for L11H5, and scaling of L11H9’s key weights.
Recomputing these edits on the other seven B/16 checkpoints, with the head indices and strengths fixed, gives a mean gain of − 1.2 -1.2 , compared with + 6.4 +6.4 for TowerBridge.
These comparisons explain the choice of a projection recipe: it captures a correction that transfers across models, while the tested internal edits provide gains mainly in their source sessions.
blocks.zh:
转移头版编辑程序. B/16 OpenAI会话没有 D\ mathbf{D} 产生一个最后一个块块补丁, 以获得 + 8.8 + 8.8 Flickr30k val RSUM 的源代码模式 。
它结合了L11H0输出的反射,L11H5的数值偏移和L11H9键重的缩放.
在其他七个B/16检查点上重新计算这些编辑,并固定头指数和长处,平均收益为-1.2-1.2,而TowerBridge为+ 6.4+6.4。
这些比较可以解释预测食谱的选择:它捕捉到一个跨模型转移的校正,而被测试的内部编辑主要在其源会话中提供收益.

blocks.en: H Agent Protocol and Paired Evidence
blocks.zh: H 代理协议和保有证据

blocks.en: The harness fixes tools, permitted edits and feedback while leaving the choice of intervention to the agent.
blocks.zh: 控制器修复工具,允许编辑和反馈,同时将干预的选择留给代理人。

blocks.en: H.1 The Prompt and Paired Evidence
blocks.zh: H.1 迅速和有保证的证据

blocks.en: Astra denotes GPT-6-Astra (configured as gpt-6-astra ) operating through our harness with its native tools disabled. The prompt describes both towers, reports baseline recalls and lists known CLIP issues as hypotheses. The agent chooses which components to edit. Section K reproduces the prompt excerpts, tool description and B/32 program.
blocks.zh: Astra 表示 GPT-6- Astra( 被称作 gpt-6- astra ) , 使用本地工具在我们的控制下运行。 该示意图将这两座塔楼、报告基线以及已知的CLIP问题列为假设。 代理选择要编辑的组件 。 K节转载了即时节录,工具描述和B/32程序.

blocks.en: For up to 16 chosen image/text component pairs, crossmap returns d × d d\times d blocks of our matched-versus-hard-negative statistic (Eq. ( 1 )). It uses 5 wrong images per caption and 25 wrong captions per image. The B/32 program sums the supplied component blocks to recover 𝐃 \mathbf{D} . The interface permits edits along their singular directions, shared output maps and re-mining on a patched model. Before these sessions we had used 𝐃 \mathbf{D} on OpenAI B/16 to choose components for expert patches. An earlier signed eight-direction edit gained 16.1 16.1 COCO val RSUM. The prompt included neither result.
blocks.zh: 对于最多16个所选的图像/文本组件对子,交叉映射返回 d × d d\times d 块的匹配-硬-负统计 (Eq. (1 )). 它每条标题使用5个错误的图像,每张图像使用25个错误的标题. B/32 程序将所提供的组件块进行总和以恢复 D\ mathbf{D} 。 界面允许沿其单向编辑,共享输出地图并重新挖掘补丁模型. 在这些会话之前, 我们在 OpenAI B/16 上使用 D\ mathbf{D} 来选择专家补丁的组件 。 早先签署的8个方向编辑获得了16.1 16.1 COCO val RSUM. 该提示没有包含结果。

blocks.en: Nine sessions attenuated negative-eigenvalue directions. The B/32 program selected the lowest d / 4 d/4 and applied the mild uniform shrink used in round one. All 13 sessions requested fresh negatives, mostly to re-check the margin. B/16 DFN-2B also used them for its final projection rewrite. We added a fixed second round with re-mining and strength 0.05 0.05 (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 九会减弱了负价值方向。 B/32程序选择了最低的d / 4 d/4,并应用了第1轮使用的轻度制服收缩. 所有13个课程都要求提供新的负数,主要是重新检查差值。 B/16 DFN-2B也将其用于其最终投影重写. 我们增加了一轮固定的第二轮,重新出矿,兵力为0.050.05(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: H.2 Tools and Data Access
blocks.zh: H.2 工具和数据存取

blocks.en:
The tools let the agent inspect the model, construct an edit and assess its effect within fixed budgets: Tool Function Calls python Compute over weights without gradients 300 probe Inspect activations and head contributions 30 crossmap Obtain componentwise blocks of 𝐃 \mathbf{D} 20 evaluate Score patches on the selection set 100 test Score COCO val and the ImageNet proxy 50 Edits are computed from the construction set of 35,000 COCO Karpathy-train images with five captions each, which the agent can read item by item.
The selection set contains 5,000 other Karpathy-train images; evaluate returns only aggregate scores on it.
The test tool evaluates COCO Karpathy val and a 5,000-image ImageNet proxy.
No tool reports Flickr30k, full ImageNet or SugarCrepe results.
These access rules describe the original 13 sessions.
The later controls in Sec. G.4 use a different harness, and the sessions in Sec. G.6 use that later harness with 𝐃 add \mathbf{D}_{\mathrm{add}} and a held-out composition check added; neither changes the protocol of the original sessions.

选集中包含有5000个其他的Karopathy-train图像;评价返回的只有其中的总分.
测试工具评价了COCO Karopathy val和一个5000-image ImageNet代理.
没有工具报告 Flickr30k , 完整图像网 或 SugarCrepe 结果 。
这些访问规则描述了最初的13届.
sec.G.4中的后期控制使用不同的控制带,而Sec.G.6中的会话则使用后期使用 D 添加 \ mathbf{ D}_{\ mathrm{add}} 并添加了被搁置的成分检查;既不改变原会话的协议.

blocks.en: H.3 Permitted Edits and Patch Selection
blocks.zh: H.3 允许的编辑和补丁选择

blocks.en:
The editing interface covers both output projections and internal encoder components, so the agent can test where a correction is most useful.
It supports seven kinds of edit: Kind Permitted operation H1 Low-rank update of a projection H2 Scale a head or remove a subspace from its output H3 Masked rank-one edit of an MLP output H4 Rank-one rewrite on a projection or head H5 Low-rank update of a block’s attention or MLP output H6 Apply one shared matrix to both projections H8 Rewrite up to four whole tensors Together, H1–H6 edits may use total rank at most 8 and at most 12 heads.
The four whole-tensor rewrites allowed by H8 are counted separately.
Internal edits (H2, H3, H5, H4 on a head, and H8 on a block) are available in every session; the agent chooses whether to use them or edit the projections.
All edits must be computed in closed form; gradients, iterative fitting and regression to data targets are disallowed.
blocks.zh:
编辑界面既包括输出预测,也包括内部编码器组件,因此代理可以测试校正最有用的地方.
它支持七种编辑: Kind operation operation H1 低等更新投影 H2 缩放一个头或从它的输出H3 Masked 排名一中去掉一个子空间 编辑 MLP 输出 H4 Rank-one 重写在投影或标题 H5 低等更新一个块的注意力或 MLP 输出 H6 将一个共享矩阵应用于两个预测 H8 重写最多四个整分数 H1-H6编辑器加在一起,可能使用总排名,最多为8个,最多为12个头.
H8允许的4个全高分重写被分别计算.
每个会话都有内部编辑(H2,H3,H5,H4在一头,H8在一块),代理选择是使用还是编辑预测.
所有编辑都必须以封闭的形式计算;不允许梯度、迭接和回归数据目标。

blocks.en:
A tested patch replaces the current incumbent only if it improves COCO validation RSUM by more than two paired standard errors and passes the accuracy guard: at most a 0.5-point drop on the ImageNet proxy.
The final incumbent is the session’s output.
blocks.zh:
一个被测试的补丁只有在改进了COCO验证RSUM时,才能替换出两个以上对齐的标准出错并通过精度守备:最多在ImageNet代理上降0.5分.
最后一名是会议的产出。

blocks.en: H.4 Test Evaluation and Audit
blocks.zh: H.4 测试评价和审计

blocks.en:
COCO Karpathy test and Flickr30k test are sealed: no tool can read them.
Each final patch is evaluated once after its session, with the evaluation rows committed before test data are loaded.
For the frozen TowerBridge recipe, correction matrices are hash-locked before the single COCO test evaluation.
Flickr30k test results are reported for both agent-free methods and completed agent sessions; no test score is returned to the agent.
blocks.zh:
可可 Karpathy测试和Flickr30k测试被封:没有工具可以读取.
每个最终补丁在会话后评价一次,在加载测试数据前承诺评价行.
对于被冷冻的Tower Bridge配方,在单一COCO测试评价前,修正矩阵被散列.
Flickr30k测试结果既针对无剂方法,也针对已完成的剂会;不向剂会归还测试分.

blocks.en:
We statically audit every Python block for prohibited fitting operations and manually trace every array in the 13 final patches to the code that produced it.
All 13 patches satisfy the editing rules.
Table S26 records 8 as valid and 5 as valid with a selection caveat: many development tests, including a panel of up to 40 candidates; an incumbent accepted by a narrow margin; or, in one session, an edit family tested after the session’s own gate for it had failed.
These caveats concern selection optimism, not rule violations.
Each COCO test gain is within 1.5 RSUM of its development gain.
blocks.zh:
我们静静地检查每一个Python区块 禁止的安装操作 并手动追踪13个最后补丁中的每一个阵列 追踪产生它的代码
所有13个补丁都满足了编辑规则.
表S26记录8是有效的,5是有效的,并附有一项选择说明:许多发展测试,包括最多40名候选人的小组;在职者以微小的差额接受;或者,在一次会议上,编辑家庭在会议本身的大门之后因失败而接受测试。
这些警告涉及选择乐观,而不是违反规则。
COCO的每个测试收益都在开发收益的1.5瑞郎以内。

blocks.en:
The original study has one session per checkpoint with a proprietary agent. Its intervals measure evaluation uncertainty.
Later repeated controls test evidence access within their harness, rather than rediscovery across the original 13 models.
The archived B/32 program reproduces the first-round projection edit. Section F specifies the complete two-round recipe.
blocks.zh:
原研究每个检查点各设一期,专有代理. 其间隔衡量评价的不确定性。
后来反复控制测试证据在他们的被套内的访问,而不是在最初的13个模型中重新发现.
存档的B/32程序转载了第一轮投影编辑. 节次 F指定了完整的两轮配方.

blocks.en: I First-Order Analysis of the Correction
blocks.zh: 一、对更正的初步分析

blocks.en: For fixed negatives, sym ⁡ ( 𝐃 ) \mathrm{sym}(\mathbf{D}) gives the gradient of the bilinear margin. With fixed embeddings and re-mined negatives, it gives a supergradient. A bounded linear optimization then gives the form of the shrink. The experiments determine the rank, strengths and number of rounds and test the resulting edit under cosine retrieval.
blocks.zh: 对于固定的负数, sym QQ (D )\ mathrm{ sym} (\ mathbf{ D }) 给出双线边距的梯度 。 有了固定嵌入和再入底片,它给出了超级. 边框线性优化然后给出收缩的形式. 实验确定分级,强项和轮数,并测试在余弦检索下产生的编辑.

blocks.en: I.1 How the Edit Changes Similarity

blocks.en:
TASK. You are given the weights of an image-text retrieval
model, CLIP ViT-B/32 (the original OpenAI weights). It has two
towers that share no weights. The image tower is a vision
transformer: a 224x224 image is cut into 7x7 patches of 32x32
pixels, plus one class token; 12 layers (blocks) of width 768,
each with 12 attention heads of size 64 and an MLP of width
3,072 (QuickGELU, x * sigmoid(1.702 x), in both towers),
LayerNorm before each sublayer; the class token’s final state
goes through a final LayerNorm and a 768x512 projection. The
text tower is a causal transformer over at most 77 BPE tokens
(vocabulary 49,408): 12 layers of width 512, each with 8
attention heads of size 64 and an MLP of width 2,048,
LayerNorm before each sublayer; the state at the end-of-text
token goes through a final LayerNorm and a 512x512 projection.
Both towers end in the same 512-dimensional space, and an
image and a text are matched by the cosine similarity of their
embeddings. Your job is to UNIFY THE TWO TOWERS by EDITING
THEIR WEIGHTS DIRECTLY. Each tower writes into the shared
space through its components (attention heads, MLP neurons,
the projection). Read the pretrained weights of BOTH towers,
find which image-tower components and which text-tower
components express the same content and which disagree or
write tower-specific content, and edit them so that the two
towers agree: one shared representation that generalises to
any dataset of captioned photos, not just COCO.

blocks.en: The second listing is the list of known issues, which the prompt presents as hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 第二个清单是已知问题的清单,即即时提出的假设。

blocks.en:
KNOWN ISSUES OF CLIP-LIKE MODELS. Published work reports
several general issues of CLIP-like image-text models. They
are hypotheses to check, not established facts about this
model and not the answer: check whether each applies here
before relying on it; some may not matter here, and something
not listed may matter more. Retrieval on COCO does not test
every one of them (counting, negation and attribute binding,
for example, are rare in its captions). (1) The modality gap:
image embeddings and text embeddings have been reported to
occupy two separate narrow cones of the shared space (Liang et
al. 2022). (2) Hubness: a few items are the nearest neighbours
of many queries, so they are retrieved for queries they do not
match (Radovanovic et al. 2010; Bogolin et al. 2022). (3)
High-norm artifact tokens: in some vision transformers a few
patch tokens acquire very large norms, carry little local
content and are read by attention as sinks, as if they were
registers (Darcet et al. 2024); whether this happens in this
model, and whether it matters for retrieval, is to be checked.
(4) Bag-of-words behaviour: weak sensitivity to word order and
to which attribute belongs to which object (Yuksekgonul et al.
2023). (5) Weak counting and weak negation. (6) A short
effective text length: it has been reported that most of the
information comes from the first 20 or so tokens of a text
(Zhang et al. 2024, Long-CLIP). (7) Tower-specific dimensions:
directions of the shared space that one tower writes and the
other ignores.

blocks.en:
6. A crossmap tool with a budget of 20 maps: the
correspondence between the two towers’ components. Reply with
your explanation followed by exactly one block that starts
with ‘‘‘crossmap and contains JSON: {"mode": "data", "weights"
or "both" (default "both"), "vision": [component, ...] or
{"layers": [l, ...]}, "text": the same for the text tower,
"k": the number of output directions per component in the
weights map (1 to 64, default 8), "pairs": [[image-tower
component, text-tower component], ...] (optional, at most 16;
data map only), "patch": {...} (optional: map the patched
model instead of the unedited one), "negatives": "fixed" or
"remined" (optional, with a "patch" and the data map; default
"fixed", see below)}. Components are named "LxHy" (head y of
block x, for example "L3H1"), "Lxmlp" (the MLP of block x),
"embed" (the input embedding at the class / end-of-text token)
and "biases" (the attention output biases and the final
LayerNorm’s bias); {"layers": [l, ...]} means every head and
the MLP of those blocks ({"layers": "all"} for all twelve;
more names with "add": [...]); at most 160 per tower;
everything of a tower you do not name is collected into one
more component, "rest". The data map (modes "data" and "both";
the photos and captions of the construction half of the
discovery data only; it uses a fixed subsample of 5,000
construction photos with their 25,000 captions, the same in
every map and listed in index.json, since the per-component
arrays of all 35,000 photos would not fit; hard negatives are
mined among these): an item’s embedding is the exact sum of
its components’ direct contributions (as in a probe’s
head_contrib arrays), each divided by the embedding’s norm, so
the cosine of a photo and a caption is the sum over all pairs
(i, j) of an image-tower component i and a text-tower
component j of <c_i(photo), c_j(caption)>. This is a
decomposition of one forward pass, not a causal effect: a
direct contribution leaves out everything the component
changes in later blocks of its tower (their inputs, and the
final LayerNorm’s statistics), so editing a component can
change the map in ways its own entry does not show. The map
gives match[i, j], the mean of <c_i, c_j> over matched
photo-caption pairs, and M[i, j] = match[i, j] minus the same
mean over hard negatives (each caption with the 5 wrong photos
that score highest for it, and each photo with the 25 wrong
captions that score highest for it), averaged over the two
directions (also given separately): a positive M[i, j] means
the pair adds more similarity to right pairs than to the
hardest wrong ones, a negative one the opposite, and M sums to
the mean hard-negative margin. A negative entry is evidence
about this margin on these photos and captions, not proof that
a component is defective (some "wrong" pairs are valid
matches). For a patched model the hard negatives are by
default those of the unedited model, kept fixed, since moving
negatives change the quantity being compared (the map is then
labelled "fixed negatives (original model)"); with
"negatives": "remined" they are mined again with the patched
model instead (labelled "re-mined negatives (patched model)").
The map also gives each component’s mean contribution, and for
each of "pairs" the 512 x 512 matrix (matched minus
hard-negative mean of c_i c_j^T) whose trace is M[i, j]; its
singular vectors are the shared-space directions along which
the pair carries its evidence on these data. In this session
the data map, like any closed-form statistic of the discovery
data, may also enter an edit directly (for example a singular
direction of a pair’s matrix; see RULES). The weights map
(modes "weights" and "both"; no data): each named head or MLP
is taken as A = shared_write(tower, layer, head or "mlp") (its
output weights carried into the shared space, below) with its
k strongest output directions (the top k left singular vectors
of A and their singular values). W_sub[i, j] is the mean
squared cosine of the principal angles between the k
directions of i and the k directions of j, and W_energy[i, j]
the same overlap weighted by the squared singular values (the
cosine between the two truncated output covariances A_k
A_k^T); beside each, a null: the same quantity with the text
component’s k directions replaced by random directions of the
shared space (200 draws; its mean and 95th percentile), since
subspaces overlap by chance. Both say where two components can
write the same content in the shared space, not whether they
do on real inputs. Everything is saved in /work/crossmap_<k>/
(crossmap.npz, README.txt with every definition, index.json)
and you get a short summary; a data map takes a minute or two,
a weights map seconds. A request that is not valid or fails
does not count against the budget.

blocks.en:
RULES. This session is GRADIENT-FREE AND DATA-ADAPTIVE: its
results will be reported as gradient-free, data-adaptive
editing, not as editing from the weights alone. (a) Where the
numbers of an edit may come from. Every numerical vector,
matrix or mask in an edit (u, v, q, A, B, a, b, mask, and
every H8 file) must be computed in closed form from the
weights of either tower or both and from statistics of the
discovery data, of probe activations and of the crossmap’s
data map, which may be used directly in the edit. Allowed
statistics: means and differences of means, covariances and
cross-covariances, correlations, whitening (inverse square
roots of covariances), and eigen- and singular-value
decompositions of any of these, including of paired
photo-caption statistics and of the data map (for example its
pair_D matrices); products of such statistics with weight
matrices; and masks built by ranking or thresholding a
statistic. Closed-form moment estimators built from these are
allowed, for example an orthogonal (Procrustes-type) map from
the singular value decomposition of a photo-caption
cross-covariance, or a canonical-correlation-type map from
whitened cross-covariances; if you use one, say so in your
explanation and name it as such. (b) Not allowed, in any step
of a computation whose result enters an edit: gradients of any
kind (backward passes, autograd, finite-difference estimates
of the gradient of a score with respect to many numbers);
optimizers and iterative fitting (SGD, Adam, alternating or
EM-style updates, iterative solvers, any loop that improves a
loss or a score step by step); regression or least squares
against targets (lstsq, normal equations, a pseudo-inverse or
a linear solve of data against data targets, ridge, logistic
or any other regression, and estimators that fit by regression
or by iteration, such as scikit-learn’s CCA, PLS, regressors,
KMeans or ICA); and fitting any vector or matrix to a loss.
Pseudo-inverses and linear solves of weight matrices, and
inverses or inverse square roots of covariances for whitening,
are not regression and are allowed. (c) Choosing. Discovery
data, probes, the crossmap, describe, evaluations and tests
may also be used to choose: which components to edit, which of
several candidates to use, and ONE strength per edit (its
alpha or scale; for H6 one common factor that multiplies the
whole alpha list; for H8 at most one scalar, as in WRITING
WHOLE MATRICES), from a dose-response or from a formula.
Measuring many settings and keeping the best is selection: use
it for these choices, not to tune many numbers of an edit one
at a time. (d) Validity. A patch with any array that breaks
(a) or (b), in any of its edits, makes the session invalid as
a success, whatever its scores; this is judged after the
session from your code (every Python run and every script in
/work is kept, see RECORD OF YOUR WORK), independently of the
results. If you are unsure whether a construction is allowed,
do not use it in an edit. (e) No running of the model other
than through the probe, evaluate, test and crossmap tools: do
not implement or simulate either tower’s computation on any
input in the kernel; multiplying probe activations by weight
matrices, to analyse what a component writes or to carry a
statistic of activations into the space of a weight matrix, is
allowed; chaining layers to compute the network’s output on an
input is not. (f) No internet access or search (there is
none). (g) No change to the model other than through a patch
of H1 to H6 and H8 edits. Allowed: any analysis of the weights
and of probe, map, evaluation and test results; products and
decompositions of the two towers’ weights with each other (for
example shared_write of components of both towers); the
closed-form statistics of (a) inside edits; writing whole
matrices for H8 from them; and any patch you compute that is
in scope and follows (a) to (c).

blocks.en:
The ViT-B/32 session’s program. The listing is the program, written by the agent, that builds the projection edit of its final patch.
It sums the 16 blocks returned by the session’s second crossmap call, computed on the unedited model, into the whole-embedding statistic, and writes the two replacement projections, which the patch installs as whole-tensor (H8) edits.
The code uses the stored projection layout, so right-multiplication by the transposed map implements Eq. ( 2 ).
The final patch also scales one text-tower head, L10H3, by 1.5 1.5 .
In the listing, a line that continues the previous one is indented four further spaces.
blocks.zh:
ViT-B/32会议方案。 上市是代理者所撰写的程序,用于构建其最终补丁的投影编辑.
它将会话第二次交叉图调回的16个区块(在未经编辑的模型上计算)合并为整体嵌入式统计,并写出两个替换预测,补丁作为整分(H8)编辑。
代码使用被存储的投影布局,因此由被移植的地图执行 Eq. (2 .)进行右乘.
最后的补丁还用1.5 1.5来缩放一个文本取高头,L10H3.
在列表中,一条延续上一条的行会缩入另外四个空格.

# Hypothesis: attenuating 128 original negative-evidence
    directions preserves useful shared discrimination.
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh

work = Path("/work")
with np.load(work / "crossmap_2/crossmap.npz") as source:
    D = source["pair_D"].astype(np.float64).sum(axis=0)
eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigh((D + D.T) / 2)
assert np.all(eigenvalues[:128] < 0)
weights = np.zeros(512)
weights[:128] = 1.0
negative_projector = (eigenvectors * weights[None, :]) @
    eigenvectors.T
rank128_transform = np.eye(512) - 0.1 * negative_projector

rank128_relative_updates = {}
for tower, tensor_name in [
    ("vision", "visual.proj"),
    ("text", "text_projection"),
]:
    original = load_original(tensor_name).astype(np.float64)
    replacement = (original @
        rank128_transform.T).astype(np.float32)
    target = work / f"spectral_rank128_0.1_{tower}.npy"
    assert replacement.shape == original.shape
    assert np.isfinite(replacement).all()
    assert np.linalg.norm(replacement) <= 3 *
        np.linalg.norm(original)
    if target.exists():
        assert np.array_equal(np.load(target), replacement),
            "Tested-array reconstruction mismatch"
    np.save(target, replacement)
    rank128_relative_updates[tower] = float(
        np.linalg.norm(replacement - original) /
            np.linalg.norm(original)
    )
